items.title: Craft CMS: Missing authorization check allows non-admin control panel users to reorder Global Sets
items.summary:
The `reorder-sets` action in Craft CMS’s `GlobalsController` is missing the `requireAdmin()` check that the adjacent `save-set` and `delete-set` actions both enforce. Any authenticated control panel user can POST to `/actions/globals/reorder-sets` and permanently reorder all global sets in the project config, regardless of whether they have admin access. The reordering is written through to the project config and persists across requests.

## Description

`GlobalsController` exposes three administrative actions for managing global set structure. Two of them gate on admin status; the third does not.

## Prerequisites

- A Craft CMS instance with at least two global sets and a non-admin control panel user account.

## Impact

A non-admin control panel user can reorder all global sets. While this does not expose or modify content, reordering global sets modifies the project config -- a versioned artifact that is typically committed to source control and deployed across environments. An attacker can create noise in the project config history, trigger config-sync conflicts, or manipulate the display order seen by all editors in the admin panel. The same non-admin user cannot create or delete global sets because those actions correctly enforce `requireAdmin()`.

items.title: league/commonmark: Quadratic-time denial of service when parsing crafted Markdown
items.summary:
### Impact

Affected versions of `league/commonmark` can have quadratic time complexity when parsing specially crafted Markdown lines. In practical terms, doubling the length of an affected line can make the parser perform roughly four times as much work. The parser identifies locations using character positions, but regular-expression matches report byte positions. These positions differ when a UTF-8 character uses more than one byte. Several parsing paths repeatedly rescan growing portions of the line to translate between the two positions. The Autolink extension can also copy and validate the remaining line at every URL-like prefix.

In current 2.x releases, a single non-ASCII character anywhere on a line can place that whole line on the slower multibyte path. An attacker can combine it with a long run of leading whitespace or repeated Markdown punctuation, causing increasingly large rescans. When the Autolink extension is enabled, repeated URL-like prefixes provide another trigger, even on ASCII-only lines. Each trigger fits within one long line, so complex Markdown structure is unnecessary.

An attacker who can submit Markdown for conversion can use a comparatively small request to consume disproportionate CPU time and allocation activity. Repeated or concurrent requests can occupy all available PHP workers and prevent legitimate requests from completing. The core paths affect `CommonMarkConverter`, `GithubFlavoredMarkdownConverter`, and custom environments. The autolink-specific path affects applications using `AutolinkExtension` or `GithubFlavoredMarkdownExtension`. Applications that process only trusted Markdown are not remotely exploitable. The impact is limited to availability: it does not disclose data, change rendered output, or bypass rendering restrictions. Settings such as `html_input` and `allow_unsafe_links` do not mitigate the issue because the expensive work occurs before rendering.

### Patches

The issue is patched in `2.9.0` and later. Starting in that release, the parser records UTF-8 character-to-byte positions incrementally, converts ordered regular-expression match positions without restarting from the beginning of the line, and matches autolinks against the original line instead of copying every remaining suffix. The affected work then grows in direct proportion to the input size while preserving existing Markdown output and configuration behavior. Versions from `0.6.0` through `2.8.3` are affected. The 0.x and 1.x release lines are no longer supported, so their users must upgrade to `2.9.0` or later.

### Workarounds

If you cannot upgrade immediately, reject or truncate inputs with excessively long individual lines before passing them to the converter. A total request-size limit is also useful, but a per-line limit is important because every demonstrated trigger fits on one line. Choose limits appropriate for the application and enforce them before Markdown parsing begins. Restricting conversion to trusted users, applying strict execution-time limits, rate-limiting requests, and limiting concurrent conversions can further reduce exposure, but these measures are not complete substitutes for upgrading.

Disabling `AutolinkExtension` and avoiding `GithubFlavoredMarkdownExtension` removes the autolink-specific trigger, but the core multibyte parsing paths remain reachable in the standard parser. Existing nesting, delimiter, raw-HTML, and unsafe-link configuration options do not eliminate all affected paths. Applications that must continue processing untrusted Markdown should therefore enforce input limits even when autolinking is disabled.

items.title: Mermaid configuration APIs allow prototype pollution
items.summary:
### Summary

Mermaid's configuration setters (`mermaid.initialize`, `mermaidAPI.setConfig`, and `mermaidAPI.updateSiteConfig`) merge the caller-supplied configuration object into Mermaid's internal config using the `assignWithDepth` deep-merge helper that is vulnerable to prototype pollution.

Because these APIs are intended to receive **trusted** configuration supplied by the application integrating Mermaid, Mermaid assesses the practical risk as **low**. The vulnerability is only reachable if an application forwards attacker-controlled data directly into one of these configuration entry points, which is outside their documented usage.

User-controlled configuration (e.g. configuration in diagram code using `%%{init: {}}%%` or YAML frontmatter) are already protected from prototype pollution.

### Patches

This has been patched in https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/commit/2cd6dcf735533b323507e3e889ffdea870540b43 and released in [Mermaid v11.16.1](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/releases/tag/mermaid%4011.16.1).

A backport has been made for the v10 branch in c34b07a0815842327e70794d69b0c8c5a1e2a956 and was released in [Mermaid v10.9.8](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/releases/tag/v10.9.8)

### Impact

Mermaid believes it's unlikely that anybody is impacted, as these functions are configuration entry points expected to receive trusted, developer-controlled values as they can modify other security-relevant configuration.

### Workarounds

Don't pass user-controlled data to the `mermaid.initialize`, `mermaidAPI.setConfig`, and `mermaidAPI.updateSiteConfig` functions. Instead, users can use `%%{init: {}}%%` or YAML frontmatter in diagrams.

### Reporters

- liyi.zhou@sydney.edu.au (Liyi), https://lzhou1110.github.io/
- ziyue0530@gmail.com (Ziyue), https://zyy0530.github.io/
- cshe0476@uni.sydney.edu.au (Strick), https://str1ckl4nd.github.io/
- chng0012@uni.sydney.edu.au (Maurice), http://maurice.busystar.org/

items.title: S12X Patch Diffing with QBinDiff
items.summary: This paper presents a reverse engineering analysis of a firmware update for a commercial vehicle Brake ECU. We analyze the updater executable to extract firmware and perform differential binary analysis of the S12X architecture firmware images. Our research identifies specific changes in the recall that address undocumented vulnerabilities in legacy protocol processing. We demonstrate that the patched functionality contained critical flaws. The findings confirm the safety recall remediation was also a security patch.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对商用车制动ECU（电子控制单元）的固件更新进行了逆向工程分析。作者首先分析更新可执行文件以提取固件镜像，然后对基于S12X架构的固件执行差分二进制比较（使用QBinDiff工具）。研究识别出在召回（safety recall）中针对遗留协议处理中未文档化漏洞的具体代码更改。通过对比补丁前后固件，作者展示了被修复的功能中包含的关键缺陷，并证实该安全召回修复实质上也是一次安全补丁。这项研究为理解嵌入式系统固件更新和漏洞修复提供了实际案例，展示了如何利用差分二进制分析技术发现隐藏的安全修复。研究结果对于汽车安全领域和固件逆向工程师具有参考价值，同时也提醒安全社区关注供应链中遗留代码的安全性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 汽车制动系统属于关键安全部件，其固件更新往往隐含着安全修复。本文展示的补丁比对方法可帮助安全团队检测供应商未公开的漏洞修复，对审计车辆ECU固件和提升供应链透明度具有实际意义。

items.title: A Survey of Adversarial Efficiency Degradation for Vision Transformer by Exploiting Input-adaptive Optimization
items.summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) increasingly rely on input-adaptive inference, such as token pruning and early halting, to meet energy and latency budgets. This survey examines a recent class of adversarial efficiency degradation attacks that target these mechanisms to increase computation without necessarily degrading accuracy. We unify and compare two representative attacks, SlowFormer (a universal adversarial patch) and DeSparsify (per-image perturbations), across three popular token-pruning frameworks: A-ViT, ATS, and AdaViT. We standardize reporting using GFLOPs, accuracy loss, and an Attack Success (AS) metric that measures how much of the model's compute savings the attack takes away. Understanding these attacks is crucial for designing countermeasures that not only mitigate risk but also remain lightweight, since deployment often occurs in low-power settings such as mobile or embedded devices. To organize our analysis, we focus on three questions: how input-adaptive optimizations (e.g., token pruning and early halting) create attack surfaces for efficiency degradation; how such attacks operate in practice and which optimizations are most vulnerable; and which defenses exist today and whether they meaningfully restore efficiency under attack.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文是一篇关于针对视觉Transformer（ViT）的对抗性效率降低攻击的综述。随着ViT在边缘设备上部署，为了满足能耗和延迟预算，越来越多地采用输入自适应的推理机制，如token剪枝和提前停止。这些机制根据输入复杂度动态调整计算量，但也引入了新的攻击面。本文聚焦于一类特殊攻击：它们不追求破坏模型准确性，而是通过增加计算开销来降低推理效率，从而耗尽设备的计算资源或导致拒绝服务。文章统一并比较了两个代表性攻击：SlowFormer，一种通用对抗补丁，可附加到任意图像上；以及DeSparsify，针对每个图像生成扰动。这两个攻击被应用于三个流行的token剪枝框架：A-ViT、ATS和AdaViT进行测试。为了标准化评估，作者引入了以GFLOPs作为计算量指标、准确率损失以及攻击成功率（AS）的度量标准，其中攻击成功率衡量攻击从模型节省的计算量中夺走的比例。文章围绕三个核心问题展开分析：第一，输入自适应优化（如token剪枝和提前停止）如何为效率降低攻击创造攻击面；第二，这些攻击在实践中如何运作，哪些优化机制最为脆弱；第三，目前存在哪些防御措施，以及它们能否在攻击下有效恢复效率。总体而言，这篇综述强调了理解此类攻击对于设计既安全又轻量的防御措施的重要性，尤其考虑到移动和嵌入式设备等低功耗场景的限制。适合ViT模型设计者、边缘AI安全研究人员以及部署者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 随着ViT在移动端/嵌入式等资源受限设备上的广泛部署，输入自适应推理带来的效率提升成为关键。本文揭示的攻击可悄悄消耗掉这些节省的计算资源，导致电池耗尽、延迟增大，甚至影响物理系统的实时性。安全从业者需要关注这一新兴攻击面，以便在架构设计时加入轻量级防御。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有采用token剪枝、提前停止等输入自适应机制的ViT模型，尤其是在低功耗边缘设备上（如手机、IoT）。攻击可在不显著损失准确率的情况下，使模型计算量大幅上升，破坏系统性能。
defense_advice_zh: 设计轻量级防御机制，在不显著增加计算开销的前提下检测或缓解此类攻击。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Software installed and run as a non-privileged user may conduct improper GPU system calls to cause OOB read kernel memory access and in certain cases cause GPU UAF of arbitrary ...
items.summary:
Software installed and run as a non-privileged user may conduct improper GPU system calls to cause OOB read kernel memory access and in certain cases cause GPU UAF of arbitrary pages.



Incorrect validation of array index can lead to OOB read and potentially to GPU UAF of arbitrary pages.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-49746 是一个与 GPU 相关的内核安全漏洞。根据 NVD 描述，软件以非特权用户身份安装和运行时，可能发起不当的 GPU 系统调用，导致内核内存的越界读取（OOB read），在某些情况下还可能造成 GPU 对任意页面的释放后使用（UAF）问题。漏洞的根本原因是对数组索引的验证不正确，使得攻击者能够利用这一缺陷越界访问内核内存。越界读取可能泄露内核内存中的敏感数据，而释放后使用则可能导致系统崩溃、权限提升或进一步的内存破坏。目前尚未提供受影响的特定产品或厂商信息，CVSS 评分和 EPSS 数据也未公布。由于该漏洞可由非特权用户触发，且涉及内核级内存安全，其潜在影响较为严重。建议用户关注厂商或 NVD 的后续更新，及时应用补丁；在补丁发布前，应限制非特权用户对 GPU 功能的访问，并加强对系统日志和异常行为的监控。对于涉及 GPU 虚拟化或多租户环境的场景，更需警惕该漏洞可能带来的跨用户影响。本摘要基于公开元数据，未确认在野利用或武器化状态。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许非特权用户通过 GPU 调用触发内核越界读和 UAF，可能导致内核内存泄露及系统崩溃，甚至权限提升。需及时关注补丁并限制 GPU 访问。

items.title: Kernel software from a non-secure operating system on a platform with Trusted Execution Environment support, may cause GPU Firmware to boot up using data from non-secure memory....
items.summary:
Kernel software from a non-secure operating system on a platform with Trusted Execution Environment support, may cause GPU Firmware to boot up using data from non-secure memory.



The GPU thread of control (Firmware) uses a pointer from non-secure memory belonging to the Rich Execution Environment (REE) when saving or retrieving internal data between the tightly coupled private memory to main memory. An attacker with control over the REE kernel may modify the pointer value, corrupting the data used by the GPU Firmware.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-45198 是一个涉及 Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) 平台的安全漏洞，具体影响 GPU 固件与非安全操作系统（Rich Execution Environment, REE）之间的交互。在现代移动或桌面平台上，TEE 提供一个受保护的安全世界，用于运行可信应用，而普通的操作系统（如 Linux、Windows）运行在普通世界（REE）中。GPU 固件在管理图形处理单元时，需要在紧密耦合的私有内存（TCM）和主内存之间传输数据。在此过程中，固件使用了一个存储在主内存中的指针，该指针位于非安全内存区域，属于 REE 内核的地址空间。攻击者如果能够控制 REE 内核（例如，通过获取内核权限或利用其他内核漏洞），就可以修改这个指针的值，使其指向任意位置，从而导致 GPU 固件从攻击者控制的内存中读取或写入数据。这种指针篡改会导致 GPU 固件使用的内部数据结构被破坏，可能引发 GPU 功能异常、信息泄露，甚至可能突破 TEE 的隔离边界，使安全世界的数据暴露给普通世界。尽管该漏洞的 CVSS 得分和 EPSS 概率未公开，且尚未有已知的在野利用证据（KEV 未列出，exploit_in_the_wild 标记为 False），但其技术影响可能十分严重。由于攻击前提是已获取 REE 内核的代码执行能力，这本身已具有较高权限，但该漏洞可放大攻击者影响，从普通世界扩展到安全世界。目前受影响的具体产品或厂商尚未明确，建议用户密切关注 GPU 和平台厂商的安全公告，及时应用针对该漏洞的固件或内核补丁。同时，应遵循最小权限原则，限制内核模块的加载，并加强系统完整性监控。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可能破坏 TEE 与 REE 之间的安全边界，使普通世界攻击者通过篡改 GPU 固件使用的指针，进而影响可信执行环境中的数据机密性。尽管需要内核权限，但一旦成功可造成跨域数据泄露。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可篡改 GPU 固件使用的指针，导致固件数据损坏，可能引发 GPU 功能异常、系统崩溃，甚至可能泄露 TEE 中的敏感数据，破坏安全世界与普通世界的隔离。

items.title: A security flaw has been discovered in Power Sofware PowerISO 9.3.0.0. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality in the library C:\Windows\System32\drivers\scdemu.sys...
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in Power Sofware PowerISO 9.3.0.0. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality in the library C:\Windows\System32\drivers\scdemu.sys of the component Kernel Driver. The manipulation results in improper privilege management. The attack is only possible with local access. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Improper access control in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.
items.summary: Improper access control in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本漏洞涉及 Microsoft Purview eDiscovery 中的不当访问控制问题。该产品通常用于法律诉讼和合规场景中的电子数据展示（eDiscovery）。由于访问控制机制存在缺陷，一个已经获得合法授权（低权限）的攻击者可以通过网络远程利用此漏洞，将自身的权限提升至更高等级，从而可能读取、修改或删除敏感数据，甚至完全控制相关账户或资源。CVSS 评分为 8.8，属于高危级别，攻击复杂度低，无需用户交互，仅需低权限账号即可触发，影响机密性、完整性和可用性。目前尚未提供受影响的具体产品版本列表，也未提供厂商补丁细节。建议蓝队和安全管理员优先关注微软官方安全公告，及时部署安全更新，并考虑对 eDiscovery 服务实施严格的网络访问控制和最小权限原则，同时监控异常的高权限操作行为。由于漏洞可能被用于数据泄露或内部威胁，需要保持高警惕。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许低权限用户通过网络提升权限，直接危及敏感数据的保密性与系统完整性。CVSS 评分高，在 eDiscovery 场景中可能导致企业法律与合规数据泄露，需优先修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响机密性、完整性和可用性，可能导致权限提升、敏感数据泄露或篡改，甚至完全控制受影响的资源。

items.title: Improper verification of cryptographic signature in Microsoft Teams allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.
items.summary: Improper verification of cryptographic signature in Microsoft Teams allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-62918 是一个影响 Microsoft Teams 的高危安全漏洞，源于产品对加密签名的验证存在不当实现（Improper verification of cryptographic signature），使得未授权攻击者能够通过网络实施欺骗（spoofing）攻击。CVSS 评分为 7.5，攻击向量为网络（AV:N），攻击复杂度低（AC:L），无需任何权限（PR:N）且无需用户交互（UI:N），攻击者仅需发送构造的数据即可触发。该漏洞不影响机密性（C:N），但对完整性影响极高（I:H），意味着伪造的内容可被完全信任，可能被用于假冒用户身份、篡改消息内容或注入恶意指令，对组织的通信安全和业务信任构成严重威胁。目前，NVD 未提供受影响的 Microsoft Teams 具体产品版本，也未列入已知被利用漏洞（KEV）目录，且没有任何在野利用的确认信息，因此不应臆测其已被武器化。鉴于该漏洞的高危性质，建议企业安全团队立即关注 Microsoft 官方安全公告，跟踪补丁发布动态，并在补丁可用前采取缓解措施：限制 Teams 服务的网络暴露范围，加强网络流量的异常检测，对敏感通信实施额外的完整性验证。由于目前仅有基础元数据，缺乏技术细节，后续应持续跟踪漏洞更新，以便进行深入风险评估和更精准的防御。

items.title: When Experience Becomes Instruction: Trajectory Poisoning in Self-Evolving Agent Skill Systems
items.summary: Self-evolving skill (SES) systems distill agent trajectories into persistent skills, allowing untrusted experience to become trusted instruction. We introduce PoisonedEvolution, a trajectory-poisoning attack on this promotion process. Our skill-visible black-box attacker can inspect a target skill and contribute bounded evidence, but cannot observe private pools or evolution logic or edit the skill bank. Artifact poisoning requires Inclusion, Evolution Attribution, and Realization. Attribution is the distinctive bottleneck: the target behavior must appear causally useful, recurrent, and generalizable before promotion. We evaluate four representative security-effect families using inert canary specifications. At 10% attacker support, across six mainstream LLM evolvers in SkillClaw, PoisonedEvolution embeds target behaviors in 546/600 trials (91.0% SER). On the structurally different Trace2Skill pipeline at the same ratio, it embeds target behaviors in 369/600 trials (61.5% SER), demonstrating transfer across evolution architectures. In a representative controlled study, three consistent attacker records suffice in a 30-record batch, whereas a single record is much weaker. Ablations identify recurring support, causal framing, and domain-aligned encoding as the main determinants of success. These findings expose evidence promotion as a security boundary for self-evolving agents.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究自进化智能体技能系统中的轨迹投毒攻击。在自进化技能（SES）系统中，智能体会将过去的执行轨迹蒸馏为可复用的技能，使得不可信的经验被提升为可信的指令。作者提出 PoisonedEvolution，一种针对这一技能晋升过程的轨迹投毒攻击方法。攻击者被假设为具备技能可见能力的黑盒攻击者，即可以查看目标技能并提交有限的证据，但无法观察私有技能池、演化逻辑或直接编辑技能库。攻击成功需要满足三个条件：包含（Inclusion）、演化归因（Evolution Attribution）和实现（Realization），其中演化归因是关键瓶颈——目标行为必须在晋升前表现出因果有用性、频繁出现且具备泛化能力。作者设计了四个代表性安全效应族，使用惰性金丝雀规范进行评估。实验表明，在 10% 的攻击者支持率下，针对六个主流大语言模型演化器（在 SkillClaw 平台上），PoisonedEvolution 在 546/600 次试验中成功嵌入目标行为（成功率 91.0%）；在结构不同的 Trace2Skill 流水线上，相同比例下成功 369/600 次（成功率 61.5%），证明了攻击跨演化架构的可迁移性。在受控实验中，30 条记录批次中 3 条一致的攻击者记录足以诱导演化，而单条记录效果明显较弱。消融实验表明，重复支持、因果框架和领域对齐编码是决定成功的主要因素。该研究揭露了证据晋升机制是自进化智能体的安全边界，为构建更稳健的智能体技能系统提供了警示。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 自进化智能体系统正逐步用于自动化任务，技能晋升机制可能成为隐蔽攻击面。该研究首次系统展示轨迹投毒可导致技能库被污染，影响下游所有使用该技能的智能体，对依赖经验沉淀的AI系统安全构成实质性威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响范围包括基于LLM的自进化代理框架（如SkillClaw、Trace2Skill）以及任何采用经验-技能蒸馏机制的智能体系统。攻击可在不直接篡改技能库的前提下，通过恶意轨迹实现长期、隐蔽的技能污染，可能被用于劫持智能体行为、数据投毒或供应链攻击。
detection_signals_zh: 监控技能晋升请求中是否存在高度一致的攻击者轨迹模式，特别是重复出现的异常目标行为
分析演化过程中技能归因环节是否出现因果框架被刻意构造的样本
检测技能库中是否混入与任务无关但频繁出现的金丝雀行为特征
对新增技能进行来源审计，标记来自低可信度环境或非可信经验池的技能
defense_advice_zh: 在技能晋升机制中引入严格的来源追溯与信任分级，限制不可信经验直接进入技能池
对技能晋升进行随机化或多样性检查，防止单一攻击者记录通过重复支持操纵演化
使用因果归因验证与鲁棒性测试，确保技能行为在真实场景中具备因果必要性而非表面关联
定期审计技能库，使用金丝雀规范探测隐藏异常行为
限制攻击者的可见性，避免攻击者获取技能细节或演化逻辑
设计对抗性训练策略，让演化器对恶意轨迹样本具备鲁棒性

items.title: LoginTrap: Uncovering Task-Agnostic Phishing-Style Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks against LLM-based Web Agents
items.summary: LLM-based web agents automate user tasks by observing webpages and executing browser actions on behalf of users. As these agents operate on real web services, login becomes a sensitive authentication boundary because it involves credentials and sensitive information. Existing work shows that malicious webpage content can manipulate web agent actions, but it has not fully examined whether such content can induce login and cause end-to-end private data leakage. We study this attack surface and present LoginTrap, a task-agnostic login-inducing attack against LLM-based web agents. LoginTrap assumes a black box attacker that controls the webpage context and the induced login flow without knowing the user task or web agent internals. Under this threat model, LoginTrap uses webpage context to generate page-specific indirect injections through a fuzzing-inspired process, making login appear as a plausible prerequisite for continuing the task and guiding the agent to a controlled login page. We conduct a comprehensive analysis of LoginTrap across realistic web agent executions. The results show that LoginTrap reaches 86\% average end-to-end attack success across LLM backbones and remains effective across agent architectures and defenses. These findings identify login inducement as a systematic authentication boundary risk and motivate further research on authentication-aware defenses for web agents.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种针对基于大语言模型（LLM）的网页代理（web agent）的新型攻击方式——LoginTrap。这类代理通过观察网页内容并模拟用户执行浏览器操作来自动完成任务。在真实网络服务中，登录过程是敏感的身份认证边界，涉及凭证和隐私信息。已有研究表明，恶意网页内容可以操纵代理行为，但尚未充分探讨这些内容是否能够诱导代理执行登录操作，从而导致端到端的隐私数据泄露。LoginTrap正是针对这一攻击面展开研究。其威胁模型假设攻击者为黑盒，仅控制网页上下文和诱导登录流程，不需要知道用户任务或代理内部实现。攻击方法利用网页上下文，通过类似模糊测试的方式生成针对特定页面的间接提示注入，使登录看起来像继续任务所必需的合理前提，从而引导代理进入攻击者控制的登录页面。作者在多种真实网页代理执行场景中进行了综合分析，结果显示，LoginTrap在不同LLM后端上的平均端到端攻击成功率高达86%，且对多种代理架构和现有防御措施仍然有效。这项研究将登录诱导识别为系统性的认证边界风险，并呼吁针对网页代理开发认证感知的防御机制。该论文适合关注LLM代理安全、提示注入攻击与防御、以及身份认证安全的研究人员和蓝队工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示LLM网页代理在登录环节存在系统性认证边界风险，攻击者可绕过用户任务实现隐私泄露，影响自动化代理的广泛应用安全。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有基于LLM的网页代理，尤其是处理涉及登录操作的金融、电商、企业SaaS等场景；攻击成功率高达86%，且现有防御效果有限。
detection_signals_zh: 代理被诱导跳转到非预期登录页，且登录流程与当前任务上下文异常匹配
网页内容中出现与登录相关的隐藏指令或提示注入特征
代理在未明确授权的情况下发起登录请求或提交凭据
defense_advice_zh: 对网页代理的登录行为实施额外的人工确认或策略约束，避免自动执行
在代理流程中引入认证感知的上下文校验，识别登录必要性是否合理
对网页内容进行提示注入检测，隔离不可信来源的指令

items.title: DeepInvert: Semi-Supervised Embedding Inversion Against Obfuscated Language Models
items.summary: Cloud-based language model services routinely process prompts containing sensitive information. Obfuscation-based defenses---including ObfusLM, SentinelLMs, TextObfuscator, and DPNR---mitigate this risk by transforming prompt representations before transmission, offering a lightweight alternative to cryptographic solutions. We show these defenses provide far less protection than previously believed. We present DeepInvert, a semi-supervised embedding inversion attack that recovers original tokens from obfuscated representations with higher accuracy than prior methods. The key insight is that unlabeled obfuscated embeddings retain exploitable semantic structure despite perturbation. DeepInvert combines supervised training on labeled shadow data with a novel unsupervised consistency objective over unlabeled target embeddings, alternating between the two via a mixed training pipeline. Defense-aware adaptations further extend the attack to diverse obfuscation mechanisms across encoder-based and autoregressive architectures. Experiments on nine defenses, five tasks, and four model architectures show that DeepInvert outperforms prior attacks on most defenses. Against ObfusLM, DeepInvert achieves 73.5\% top-1 token recovery versus 26.2\% for the previous best. Our results reveal a task-dependent tension: obfuscation schemes preserving enough signal for utility also retain sufficient structure for inversion, while schemes resisting inversion collapse utility. On simpler classification tasks, some DP-based defenses can maintain both. We call for a re-evaluation of this defense class.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为 DeepInvert 的半监督嵌入逆向攻击方法，针对基于混淆的防御机制（如 ObfusLM、SentinelLMs、TextObfuscator 和 DPNR）对云端语言模型提示词进行隐私保护的场景。这些混淆防御通过在处理前转换提示词的表示形式来降低敏感信息泄露风险，被视为比密码学方案更轻量的替代方案。然而，作者证明这些防御提供的保护远低于预期。DeepInvert 能够从混淆后的嵌入表示中以高于现有方法的准确率恢复原始 token。其核心洞察在于：即使经过扰动，未标记的混淆嵌入仍保留可利用的语义结构。该方法结合了在标记影子数据上的监督训练和针对未标记目标嵌入的新型无监督一致性目标，通过混合训练流程交替优化。此外，作者还提出了防御感知的扩展版本，使其能够适应多种混淆机制，覆盖基于编码器和自回归架构的模型。实验在九种防御、五个任务和四种模型架构上进行，结果显示 DeepInvert 在大多数防御上都优于现有攻击。例如，针对 ObfusLM，DeepInvert 的 top-1 token 恢复率达到 73.5%，而之前最佳方法仅为 26.2%。研究还揭示了任务相关的矛盾：保留足够任务效用的混淆方案往往也保留了足够的结构信息用于逆向攻击，而抵抗逆转的方案则会导致效用下降。在较简单的分类任务中，某些基于差分隐私的防御可以同时维持效用和抗攻击性。作者呼吁重新评估这一类防御机制的有效性。本文对云端 LLM 服务的隐私风险提出了重要警示，适合关注大模型安全、隐私保护和对抗性攻击的研究人员及安全保障团队阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 这项研究揭示当前流行的混淆型 LLM 隐私防御可被高效逆向攻击突破，直接影响依赖此类防护的云端 AI 服务安全评估与合规决策，需引起蓝队对现有防护方案的重新审视。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有采用混淆嵌入方式保护提示词的 LLM 服务及第三方防护产品，特别是基于 ObfusLM 等方案的系统；攻击可导致用户敏感信息泄露。
detection_signals_zh: 监控对 LLM API 的异常高频请求模式，可能对应嵌入逆向攻击试探
检测模型输出中是否出现与输入提示高度相似的片段，提示可能发生了 token 恢复
对使用混淆嵌入的接口，定期执行嵌入空间相似性审计
defense_advice_zh: 避免单独依赖混淆方案，应结合差分隐私、可信执行环境等更强保护
在部署混淆防御时进行针对性的嵌入逆向攻击评估，验证实际防护强度
对于高敏感任务，限制模型返回结果中与原始 token 直接相关的信息
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Hardware Keystores for AI Agent Signing Workflows: A Zero-Trust MCP Enforcement Architecture
items.summary: AI agents performing cryptographic operations (signing Git commits, authenticating API calls, issuing certificates) currently store private keys in software-accessible locations: plaintext files, environment variables, or container memory. Any process with sufficient read privileges can extract the raw key material. A recent production incident demonstrated the practical severity: private keys were exfiltrated from a widely deployed framework via email injection in under five minutes. We aim to enforce both key confidentiality and content-aware authorisation for key use. To that end, we replace software-resident keys with hardware-confined keys accessible through a vendor-neutral PKCS#11 interface. A hardware keystore (HSM, TPM, smart card) executes cryptographic operations on-device; the host receives only the result via opaque handles. Hardware confinement is the primary contribution; it is enabled by a surrounding five-layer Zero-Trust enforcement stack comprising session identity (SAGA), scope bounds (Smax), semantic validation (RAV), taint tracking, and the hardware execution boundary. We evaluate against 12 injection scenarios derived from AgentDojo's ImportantInstructionsAttack template (Debenedetti et al., arXiv:2406.13352). We run four LLM models; three follow injections in baseline mode (gpt-oss-120b, Qwen2.5-72B, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, n=192 combined). Baseline Attack Success Rate (ASR): 19.3% [14.3%, 25.4%]; protected ASR: 0% (Wilson 95% CI upper bound 2.0%). Zero false positives across four benign task scenarios.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对 AI 智能体在执行密码学操作（如 Git 提交签名、API 调用认证、证书签发）时私钥存储不安全的问题展开研究。当前主流框架常将私钥存放在软件可访问的位置，如明文文件、环境变量或容器内存中，任何具备足够读取权限的进程都能提取原始密钥材料。作者引用了一起生产环境事故：某广泛部署的框架中，私钥通过邮件注入漏洞在不到五分钟内被窃取。为同时实现密钥机密性和面向内容的使用授权，论文提出用硬件受限密钥替代软件驻留密钥，并通过厂商中立的 PKCS#11 接口访问。硬件密钥库（HSM、TPM、智能卡）在设备内执行密码操作，主机仅能通过不透明句柄获取操作结果。硬件隔离是核心贡献，其外部还构建了五层零信任强制架构，包括会话身份（SAGA）、作用域边界（Smax）、语义验证（RAV）、污点跟踪以及硬件执行边界。实验基于 AgentDojo 的 ImportantInstructionsAttack 模板衍生出的 12 种注入场景，测试了四个 LLM 模型（gpt-oss-120b、Qwen2.5-72B、DeepSeek-V4-Flash，n=192）。基线模式下攻击成功率为 19.3%（置信区间 14.3%-25.4%），受保护模式下攻击成功率为 0%（Wilson 95% 置信区间上限 2.0%），并且在四个良性任务场景中零误报。该研究为 AI 代理的密钥管理提供了一种可落地的硬件强制方案，适合关注 AI 安全、零信任架构和密钥管理的安全研究人员及工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: AI 智能体广泛使用密钥执行自动化操作，而软件存储密钥极易被注入攻击窃取。该论文提出硬件隔离加零信任多层强制的完整方案，实测将攻击成功率从 19.3% 降至 0%，为 LLM 代理的安全密钥使用提供了可借鉴的工程范式。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于所有依赖 LLM 代理执行签名、认证、证书签发等敏感操作的系统，尤其是 Git 操作、API 调用自动化、CI/CD 流水线等场景。其 PKCS#11 接口设计可对接多种硬件安全模块，具备通用性。
detection_signals_zh: 检测代理进程对私钥文件的异常读取行为
监控环境变量或内存中出现的明文密钥
对 PKCS#11 调用链的异常模式进行审计
关注注入攻击导致的非预期密码学操作
defense_advice_zh: 将私钥迁移至 HSM/TPM/智能卡等硬件安全模块
实施最少权限原则，限制进程对密钥存储的访问
对代理的密码学操作引入语义验证和污点跟踪
部署零信任架构，对每次密钥使用进行上下文授权

items.title: MMAligner: Safeguarding Multimodal Large Language Models through Representation Calibration
items.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often refuse unsafe text prompts yet generate harmful responses to semantically equivalent multimodal inputs. Existing defenses either rely on external guardrails, which add inference overhead without repairing intrinsic flaws, or safety fine-tuning, which treats alignment as black-box optimization and may sacrifice utility or require large multimodal datasets. To identify the cause of this safety disparity, we analyze MLLM representations geometrically. We find that safety mechanisms learned from text persist across modalities: a shared safety subspace and refusal boundary remain effective, and representations inside this boundary consistently trigger refusals. However, unsafe multimodal inputs undergo a representation shift that places most of them outside the boundary, allowing them to bypass the model's intrinsic safety mechanism. This indicates that multimodal safety degradation stems from representation misalignment rather than the absence of safety capability. Based on this finding, we propose MMAligner, a safeguarding method that calibrates unsafe multimodal representations into the pre-existing refusal region. MMAligner applies a hard lower bound to ensure refusal, a soft upper bound to avoid excessive modification, and a preservation objective for benign inputs. Experiments across multiple open-source MLLMs show that MMAligner raises the average refusal rate on unsafe multimodal inputs to 99% with less than 2% utility degradation and minimal training data, substantially improving the safety-utility trade-off over existing baselines. (*Due to the notification from arXiv, "The Abstract field cannot be longer than 1,920 characters", the Abstract that appeared is shortened.)

llm_summary.summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在处理不安全文本提示时往往能够拒绝，但面对语义等价的多模态输入（如恶意图像配文本）却可能生成有害响应。现有防御手段要么依赖外部护栏，增加推理开销且无法修复模型内在缺陷；要么进行安全微调，将对齐视为黑盒优化，容易牺牲模型效用或需要大量多模态安全数据。本文对 MLLM 的表示空间进行几何分析，揭示了安全差距的根源：模型从文本中学到的安全机制可以跨模态泛化，存在一个共享的安全子空间和拒绝边界——落在边界内的表示会稳定触发拒绝；然而不安全的多模态输入会经历表示偏移，使得大部分越过边界，从而绕过内在安全机制。这说明模态安全退化并非源于安全能力的缺失，而是多模态表示与原安全区域的对齐错位。基于此，作者提出 MMAligner，一种通过表示校准来安全防护的方法。它将不安全的多模态表示主动拉回预存的拒绝区域，并采用硬下界确保拒绝触发、软上界避免过度修改、以及保存目标来维持良性输入的行为。实验在多个开源 MLLM 上进行，结果显示 MMAligner 在不安全多模态输入上的平均拒绝率提升至 99%，效用退化低于 2%，且只需要极少的训练数据，相比现有基线显著改善了安全-效用权衡。该工作不仅提供了一种可落地的防御方案，也为理解 MLLM 对齐本质提供了几何视角。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 多模态大模型的安全对齐在跨模态输入下失效，MMAligner 以极低成本修复内在缺陷，无需外部护栏，显著提升拒绝率且几乎不损失效用，对防范多模态越狱攻击具有直接价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该方案可应用于各类开源 MLLM 的安全防护，尤其适用于图像-文本联合输入的安全过滤场景，也可迁移到其他模态组合（如视频、音频）的表示校准。
defense_advice_zh: 在模型推理阶段加入表示校准层，将多模态输入映射到安全拒绝区域
监控表示向量与拒绝边界的距离，作为异常检测信号

items.title: Post-Hoc Trajectory-Risk Certification for Modular LLM-Based Security Agents
items.summary: Autonomous security agents operate as staged pipelines, such as classifying network traffic and then attributing attacks to a specific technique. Split conformal prediction gives each stage finite-sample coverage, but deployment requires a trajectory-level guarantee across the full chain. These guarantees do not compose automatically when stages are independently trained and calibrated. Bonferroni allocation is distribution-free but conservative under correlated errors. We show that a natural pairwise-correlation extension to three or more stages is invalid because it gives a lower rather than an upper bound, and derive a valid spanning-tree alternative. We distinguish whether stages are dependent from whether an audit sample is large enough to certify that dependence, and give matching upper and information-theoretic lower sample-complexity bounds. We also show that coarse-to-fine label selection can create near-perfect measured correlation without learned dependence. On a two-stage intrusion-detection pipeline across 6 open LLMs and 2 datasets, removing this artifact reduces measured correlation from near 1 to 0-0.78. A direct audit of trajectory failure becomes 13.7% tighter than Bonferroni once the audit reaches the required sample size, but is worse when undersized. A modular certificate using per-stage certificates and a pairwise overlap bound yields a positive average gain of 0.6%, quantifying the cost of lacking joint access. Same-model, cross-model, and permuted-pairing tests show that residual dependence reflects shared sample difficulty, not shared model representations. Average trajectory coverage across 12 configurations is 92.7% +/- 2.4% at alpha = 0.10. Under cross-dataset deployment, single-step miscoverage reaches 100% even when accuracy remains 78%, showing that distribution shift destroys calibrated confidence before raw accuracy.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究模块化 LLM 安全代理的轨迹级风险认证问题。此类代理通常以分阶段流水线方式工作，例如先对网络流量进行分类，再进行攻击技术归因。分裂共形预测可以为每个阶段提供有限样本覆盖保证，但部署时需要整个链路的轨迹级风险保证。由于各阶段独立训练和校准，这些单阶段保证并不能自动组合。作者首先指出，Bonferroni 分配虽然分布自由，但在误差相关时过于保守。接着，作者证明自然将两阶段成对相关扩展至三阶段及以上是无效的，因为它给出的是下界而非上界，并由此推导出一种有效的生成树替代方法。文中严格区分了“阶段之间是否存在依赖”与“审计样本是否足够大以证明这种依赖”两个概念，并给出了匹配的样本复杂度上界与信息论下界。此外，作者发现粗到细的标签选择会制造近乎完美的测量相关性，而实际上并不存在学习到的依赖。在包含 6 个开源 LLM 和 2 个数据集的两阶段入侵检测流水线实验中，去除该伪影后，测量相关性从接近 1 降至 0 到 0.78。当审计样本量达到要求时，直接审计轨迹失败比 Bonferroni 方法紧 13.7%，但样本不足时效果更差。作者提出的模块化证书（利用每阶段证书与成对重叠界）带来 0.6% 的正平均增益，量化了缺乏联合访问的代价。相同模型、跨模型和置换配对测试显示，残差依赖主要反映共享样本难度而非共享模型表示。在 12 个配置下，平均轨迹覆盖率在 alpha=0.10 时为 92.7% ± 2.4%。跨数据集部署时，即使准确率仍为 78%，单步错误覆盖率却达到 100%，表明分布偏移会在原始准确率下降之前破坏校准置信度。该研究为多阶段安全代理提供了轨迹级可靠性认证的理论基础，并揭示了伪相关与分布偏移的潜在危害。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 对依赖 LLM 的多阶段安全代理而言，仅评估单步准确率远远不够。本文提供轨迹级风险认证方法，并揭示分布偏移如何先于准确率摧毁校准置信度，是构建可信自主安全系统的关键参考。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至基于 LLM 的入侵检测、网络流量分析、自动响应编排等多阶段安全流水线，也可用于任何需要端到端不确定性保证的模块化 ML 系统。
defense_advice_zh: 在多阶段安全代理中采用模块化轨迹级证书，避免仅依赖单阶段覆盖。
监控跨数据集部署时的校准置信度退化，不要只关注原始准确率。
警惕粗到细标签选择导致的伪相关，使用置换测试验证真实依赖。

items.title: Breadcrumbing Search Agents
items.summary: LLM-based search agents are widely used for information-seeking tasks, but their reliance on external tool returns introduces a critical security risk: web content retrieved during execution is untrusted, exposing agents to prompt injection and goal hijacking. Prior work on search-agent safety primarily focuses on static web-content injection, but modern agents issue follow-up queries and cross-check competing sources, so a single injected page is often diluted or rejected. We show that the channel delivering search and page observations is a fragile security boundary: beyond exposing the agent to a single poisoned page, a mediated search interface can repeatedly steer how the agent gathers evidence and forms its final answer. Under a constrained tool-intermediary threat model, appending only one controlled result per query can substantially increase attack success when the evidence is coordinated across the agent's trajectory. We study this setting with a strategy-driven long-horizon attack system and introduce Authority-Chain Hijack (ACH), an expert-refined strategy that turns isolated search-result and page-content manipulations into a coherent evidence chain across seemingly corroborating sources. ACH achieves the highest Overall ASR among all baselines, reaching 55.9% / 83.3% ASR / MaxN ASR on the full SafeSearch test split. We further introduce Trace-Guided Strategy Evolution (TGSE), which automatically improves attacker strategies from execution traces, replacing manual redesign with trace-driven refinement; its strongest single setting reaches 71.4% / 95.0% in held-out evaluation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究基于大语言模型（LLM）的搜索代理面临的安全威胁，特别是通过操纵搜索结果来实施提示注入和目的劫持的攻击。现有防御研究主要关注静态网页的单一注入，但现代搜索代理会进行多轮查询并交叉验证多源信息，导致单点注入往往被稀释或忽略。作者发现，代理所依赖的搜索结果和页面内容传递通道本质上是一个脆弱的安全边界，攻击者可通过控制一个中间工具接口，在每次查询中附加一个受控结果，并沿着代理的整个执行轨迹协调这些注入，从而显著提高攻击成功率。为此，作者提出一种策略驱动的长时程攻击框架，并引入专家精炼策略——权威链劫持（ACH），该策略能够将分散的搜索结果和页面内容篡改整合为一条围绕看似相互印证的多来源证据链，从而有效误导代理生成错误结论。在SafeSearch基准测试上，ACH取得了最高的攻击成功率，总体ASR为55.9%，MaxN ASR达83.3%。此外，论文还提出追踪引导策略进化（TGSE）方法，能够根据代理的执行轨迹自动改进攻击策略，避免了人工重新设计，其最强配置在留出集上达到71.4%的ASR和95.0%的MaxN ASR。本工作揭示了LLM搜索代理在工具交互层面的新安全弱点，对设计更健壮的代理防御机制具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次系统性地展示了通过中介搜索接口实施跨轨迹协调注入的威胁，突破了传统单点注入防御。搜索代理在AI应用中广泛部署，此风险直接影响依赖实时检索的助手、RAG系统等，提示安全社区需重视工具层的可信边界。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该攻击模式可迁移至任何基于LLM的工具调用场景，如：AI驱动的浏览器、企业知识库检索、自动化研究助手等。由于只需控制少量搜索结果，对敌对服务提供商或恶意网页具有较低实施门槛。

items.title: Trident : How to Break Deep Reinforcement Learning Cyber Defenses (Agentic)
items.summary: Autonomous cyber defense systems based on Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) have attracted significant research attention, yet remain evaluated almost exclusively against static, heuristic red agents, leaving their robustness against adaptive threats critically understudied. Meanwhile, recent advances in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) have improved LLM reasoning, but their integration into cybersecurity remains elusive due to the absence of suitable benchmark environments and interaction datasets. To bridge this gap, we introduce Trident, an agentic LLM red teaming framework comprising three components: a dynamic benchmark with isolated sandbox servers spanning CybORG CAGE 4 and CyberWheel, a dataset comprises over 13,000 high-fidelity red-blue interaction trajectories for RLVR, and a ``Code-as-Policy'' RLVR agentic architecture Trident Agentic). The latter reformulates red agent training as a contextual bandit via a tripartite Log Summarizer--Planner--Coder design, where a trainable Planner generates complete attack strategies from compressed execution logs, which a frozen Coder translates into executable Python policies deployed against live DRL defenders. Empirical evaluations reveal a fundamental brittleness in existing defenses: with a single trainable 7B planner, Trident reduces blue agent defensive performance by an average of 522% compared to static red agent baselines while autonomously discovering emergent behaviors such as decoy avoidance and adaptive state prioritization that static heuristics entirely fail to uncover.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对基于深度强化学习（DRL）的自主网络防御系统鲁棒性研究不足的问题，提出了一种名为 Trident 的智能体化大语言模型（LLM）红队框架。当前 DRL 防御模型几乎只用静态、启发式红队进行评测，无法反映真实自适应攻击者的威胁；同时，具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）虽已提升 LLM 推理能力，但缺少可用于网络安全的基准环境与交互数据集。Trident 由三个组件构成：一是在 CybORG CAGE 4 与 CyberWheel 隔离沙箱中搭建的动态基准环境；二是包含超过 13,000 条高保真红蓝对抗轨迹的数据集，用于 RLVR 训练；三是“代码即策略”的 RLVR 智能体架构（Trident Agentic）。该架构将红队训练建模为上下文赌博机问题，采用“日志摘要器-规划器-编码器”三分设计：可训练的规划器根据压缩的执行日志生成完整攻击策略，冻结的编码器负责把策略转换为可运行的 Python 代码并部署，使其能攻击实时 DRL 防御者。实验表明，仅用一个可训练的 7B 规模规划器，Trident 即可让蓝方防御性能相比静态红队基线平均下降 522%，并且能自主发现诱饵规避、自适应状态优先级选择等静态启发式完全无法揭示的新兴行为。该工作揭示了现有 DRL 自主防御系统存在的根本性脆弱点，为构建更真实的红队评估平台及将 RLVR 应用于网络攻防提供了重要数据集与方法论基础。适合安全自动化研究者、DRL 防御系统开发者和红队工程师阅读。

监控防御系统在未知策略下的性能突变，尤其是当攻击者具备动态规划能力时。
对 DRL 防御训练环境引入多样化对抗策略，提高模型在攻击者适应下的泛化能力。

items.title: RustGo: Fairly Directed Greybox Fuzzing for Enforcing Rust Memory Safety
items.summary: Rust is a popular systems programming language that provides strong memory safety and introduces low-performance overhead. While Rust guarantees memory safety through strict security policies, such as ownership, memory bugs can still occur in unsafe-related Rust codes where these policies are not fully enforced. Although such unsafe Rust code accounts for only a small portion of the entire code (e.g., 10%), existing approaches fuzz the entire code-including safe Rust, whose memory safety is already enforced by the Rust compiler-resulting in inefficient use of fuzzing resources. In this paper, we propose RustGo, the new Rust-directed greybox fuzzer that effectively and fairly focuses on code regions potentially containing memory bugs. For this, RustGo automatically identifies potential memory bug targets and accurately prunes the paths irrelevant to each target by leveraging Rust-specific static analysis. For each identified target, RustGo includes a new fuzzing approach that maintains an independent state and applies dynamic pruning to maximize balanced and focused fuzzing. We evaluate RustGo on various real-world Rust applications. On average, RustGo prunes 78.49% of irrelevant paths, reaches targets x 2.09 to x 5.08 faster than existing fuzzers, and identifies 13 unknown bugs (six assigned RUSTSEC IDs and one assigned CVE ID).

llm_summary.summary_zh: Rust 语言凭借所有权等严格安全策略提供内存安全保证，但 unsafe Rust 代码块会绕过这些策略，仍可能引入内存漏洞。尽管 unsafe 代码通常只占整个代码库的一小部分（例如约 10%），现有模糊测试工具却往往对整个程序进行测试，包括已经被编译器保证安全的 safe Rust 部分，造成测试资源浪费。本文提出 RustGo，一种面向 Rust 的定向灰盒模糊测试工具，能够高效且公平地聚焦于可能包含内存缺陷的代码区域。RustGo 通过利用 Rust 特有的静态分析，自动识别潜在内存缺陷目标，并精确剪枝与各目标无关的路径。针对每个识别出的目标，RustGo 维护独立状态并应用动态剪枝，以最大化平衡且聚焦的模糊测试效果。作者在多种真实 Rust 应用上评估 RustGo，结果表明：平均剪枝 78.49% 的无关路径；到达目标的速度比现有模糊器快 2.09 倍至 5.08 倍；共发现 13 个未知缺陷（其中 6 个被分配 RUSTSEC 编号，1 个被分配 CVE 编号）。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Rust 被广泛用于构建安全关键型系统，unsafe 代码仍是漏洞高发点。RustGo 能显著提升模糊测试效率，帮助安全团队在资源有限的情况下优先挖掘 unsafe 代码中的真实内存安全问题。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于所有使用 Rust 的项目，尤其是包含大量 unsafe 代码的系统级软件、嵌入式平台、加密库等，可缩短漏洞发现时间并减少计算资源消耗。

items.title: ChainClaw: A Layered Agent Framework for Reliable On-Chain Execution
items.summary: General-purpose large language model agents have achieved strong performance on tool-augmented tasks, yet they rely on assumptions break down in blockchain environments. On-chain execution is stateful, adversarial, and economically irreversible, exposing three fundamental gaps: Reactivity, Irreversibility, and Observability. We propose ChainClaw, a blockchain-native agent framework built on OpenClaw, that addresses all three gaps through a layered architecture comprising an event-driven orchestration layer, a simulation-based safety intelligence layer, and an on-chain monitoring runtime layer, unified by a cross-layer memory subsystem. ChainClaw closes the Reactivity gap via event ingestion and simulation feedback, the Irreversibility gap via a pre-execution safety pipeline with transaction simulation and action guard, and the Observability gap via an on-chain read adapter and transaction monitor. We evaluate ChainClaw on a purpose-built benchmark covering seven tasks across four categories and five dimensions. ChainClaw consistently outperforms representative baselines on both safety and task completion.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 ChainClaw，一个面向区块链环境的智能体（Agent）框架，旨在解决通用大语言模型（LLM）智能体在链上执行任务时面临的三大核心缺陷：反应性（Reactivity）、不可逆性（Irreversibility）和可观测性（Observability）。区块链环境不同于传统工具增强任务，其状态有状态性、对抗性且经济上不可逆，导致现有基于 LLM 的智能体假设（如可重试、可回滚、可完全观测）失效。ChainClaw 基于 OpenClaw 构建，采用分层架构，包括：事件驱动编排层（负责事件摄取与模拟反馈，解决反应性缺陷）、基于模拟的安全智能层（通过预执行安全流水线、交易模拟和动作护栏解决不可逆性缺陷）、链上监控运行时层（通过链上读取适配器和交易监控器解决可观测性缺陷），并由跨层记忆子系统统一协调。研究团队构建了一个专门基准测试，涵盖四个类别的七个任务，并从五个维度评估。实验结果表明，ChainClaw 在安全性和任务完成度上均优于代表性基线。该研究适合关注 LLM 智能体安全、区块链安全、可信 AI 执行系统的研究人员和工程人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次系统性地分析 LLM Agent 在链上场景的三大缺陷，并提出分层防护架构，为防御者理解区块链自动化执行风险提供参考。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 对基于 LLM 的链上交易助手、DeFi 自动化策略、智能合约交互工具等场景具有直接参考价值，可迁移到需要状态感知与不可逆操作防护的 Agent 系统。

items.title: DreamGuard: Efficient Runtime Guardrail for LLM Agents via Risk-Aware World Model
items.summary: As large language model (LLM) agents increasingly invoke external tools and interact with real-world systems, unsafe actions may cause irreversible consequences on external states, user data, and downstream services. Recent runtime guardrails mitigate such risks by checking proposed actions before execution, but many remain reactive: they primarily assess the apparent safety of the current action, lacking an explicit model of how risk evolves across the trajectory. This limitation creates a critical blind spot for long-horizon risks, where individually benign-looking actions can gradually drift the agent toward hazardous states. In response, we propose DreamGuard, a proactive guardrail for LLM agents built around a risk-aware world model. The world model maintains a compact recurrent latent state over the trajectory and predicts future latent states from which DreamGuard derives immediate-hazard and prefix-risk evidence. It then fuses these multi-horizon signals into intervention decisions before execution. Experiments across four benchmarks and an online guardrail evaluation show that DreamGuard outperforms generic, reactive, and proactive guardrail baselines, achieves the best safety-utility trade-off among evaluated guardrails, and maintains an average end-to-end latency of 25 ms per call.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理在执行任务时经常需要调用外部工具并交互真实世界系统，然而不安全的行为可能对外部状态、用户数据和下游服务造成不可逆的后果。现有的运行时防护措施（guardrails）往往在行动执行前检查其表面安全性，但它们本质上是反应式的——主要评估当前动作的即时风险，缺乏对风险如何随轨迹演变的显式建模。这种局限性造成了长期风险盲区：单个看似良性的行动可能逐渐将代理引向危险状态。为解决此问题，论文提出 DreamGuard，一种基于风险感知世界模型的主动防护方案。其核心世界模型在轨迹上维护一个紧凑的循环潜在状态，并预测未来潜在状态，据此衍生出即时危害（immediate-hazard）和前缀风险（prefix-risk）两类证据。随后，DreamGuard 在行动执行前融合这些多时间尺度信号，生成干预决策。实验在四个基准和一个在线防护评估上进行，结果显示 DreamGuard 优于通用、反应式和主动式防护基线，在已评估的防护机制中实现了最佳的安全-效用权衡，且平均端到端延迟仅为每调用25毫秒。论文的主要贡献包括：首次在代理防护中引入显式的风险演化建模；设计了可高效预测未来风险的世界模型架构；通过多尺度信号融合实现更准确的干预决策；并通过多个基准验证了有效性。适合关注 LLM Agent 安全、运行时防护和可信 AI 的研究人员与安全工程师阅读。

llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于各类 LLM Agent 应用（如自动化助手、网页操作 Agent 等）的实时安全防护，可迁移到异常行动检测、策略合规监控等场景。

items.title: Breaking Customized LLMs for Coding: Automated Red Teaming for Instruction Backdoor Attacks
items.summary: LLM customization platforms allow users to build task-specific models for code intelligence tasks by embedding instructions into system prompts, without modifying the underlying model parameters. While these platforms lower the barrier to developing customized LLMs, they also introduce a new attack surface: instruction backdoor attacks, in which adversaries implant hidden malicious behaviors into customized instructions. However, existing attacks suffer from two key limitations. First, they often rely on explicit trigger patterns readily detected by platform-side or user-side inspection. Second, they require substantial manual effort to craft task-specific backdoored instructions, limiting their scalability. In this paper, we propose ARIA, an automated red-teaming framework for crafting covert and effective backdoored instructions against customized LLMs. ARIA leverages an attacker LLM to iteratively generate and refine backdoored instructions, guided by structured feedback from the target LLM along three dimensions: stealthiness, clean-task utility, and backdoor effectiveness. We evaluate ARIA on three code intelligence tasks, using four representative LLMs, and compare it with three baseline attacks. Experimental results show that ARIA achieves the highest attack success rate of 0.945, while maintaining the best clean-task utility across all tasks. ARIA also generalizes well across programming languages and remains robust to generation temperature. Furthermore, ARIA significantly outperforms existing attacks in evading platform-side and user-side detection, achieving a false negative rate of up to 1.000, and stays effective against existing defense methods, demonstrating its strong generalizability and robustness.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了大模型定制化平台中指令后门攻击（Instruction Backdoor Attacks）的自动化红队测试方法。随着LLM定制化平台的普及，用户可以通过在系统提示词中嵌入指令来构建面向特定编程任务（如代码补全、生成、修复等）的定制模型，而无需修改底层模型参数。这种机制在降低开发门槛的同时，也引入了一种新的攻击面：攻击者可以在看似无害的指令中植入隐蔽后门。现有攻击方法存在两个主要局限：一是依赖容易被平台或用户检测的显式触发词模式；二是需要大量人工制作任务特化的后门指令，难以扩展。为此，作者提出了ARIA（Automated Red-teaming for Instruction-backdoor Attacks），这是一个自动化红队框架，能够生成隐蔽且有效的后门指令。ARIA利用一个攻击者LLM迭代式地生成和改进后门指令，并依据目标LLM在三个维度上的结构化反馈进行优化：隐蔽性、干净任务效用（clean-task utility）和后门有效性。研究在三个代码智能任务上使用四个代表性LLM进行了评估，并与三种基线攻击进行了比较。实验结果表明，ARIA的攻击成功率最高可达0.945，同时在所有任务中保持了最佳的干净任务效用；它还能跨编程语言泛化，并对生成温度保持鲁棒性。此外，ARIA在规避平台侧和用户侧检测方面显著优于现有攻击，假阴性率最高可达1.000，并且对现有防御方法仍然有效，展示了较强的泛化性和鲁棒性。本文适合大模型安全研究人员、红队工程师以及负责LLM应用防护的安全运营人员阅读，以理解指令后门的风险和自动化生成方法的进展。

items.title: Behavioral Residualization for Unsupervised Intrusion Detection in Automotive CAN Networks
items.summary: Modern vehicles rely on the Controller Area Network (CAN) bus, whose design prioritizes low cost and real-time performance but provides no message authentication or encryption. An attacker with physical or remote access can therefore inject arbitrary frames, making intrusion detection an important defense-in-depth mechanism. Most published CAN intrusion detection systems rely on presence-based features, such as novel arbitration IDs, frozen payload bytes, or anomalous DLC values. These features perform well on public datasets containing easily separable attacks but fail when attackers reuse legitimate arbitration IDs. We present per-ID behavioral residualization, a CAN-specific representation that extracts fourteen temporal, protocol, and payload features from sliding windows and residualizes them against each arbitration ID's normal baseline. Our central claim is that this representation, rather than any individual detector, drives the performance gains. Across six unsupervised detectors and two datasets, residualization improves mean F1 in the majority of evaluations (21/24 on HCRL and 30/36 on ROAD across five seeds). On the more realistic ROAD dataset, where attacks reuse legitimate IDs, the representation achieves recall >= 0.99 with high ROC-AUC on targeted signal-manipulation attacks. Two limitations are explicitly quantified: novel-ID flooding (HCRL DoS, F1 = 0.02) and cross-ID fuzzing (ROAD, F1 = 0.27), defining the measured coverage boundary of the proposed representation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 现代汽车广泛采用控制器局域网（CAN）总线，其设计以低成本和高实时性为核心，但缺乏消息认证与加密。因此，攻击者若获得物理接入或远程访问能力，便可向总线注入任意报文，使入侵检测成为纵深防御中的关键机制。已发表的多数CAN入侵检测系统依赖基于“存在性”的特征（presence-based features），例如新出现的仲裁ID（arbitration ID）、冻结的负载字节、异常的数据长度码（DLC）等。这些特征在公开数据集中表现良好，因为这些数据集的攻击模式易于区分；但当攻击者重用合法仲裁ID时，此类特征便会失效。本文提出一种CAN专用的表示方法——逐ID行为残差化（per-ID behavioral residualization）。该方法从滑动窗口中提取14种时间、协议与负载特征，并针对每个仲裁ID的正常基线进行残差化处理。作者的核心论点是：带来性能提升的主要因素是该表示本身，而非某个具体的检测器。实验采用6种无监督检测器、两个数据集（HCRL与ROAD），并基于5个随机种子进行评估。结果显示，残差化表示在大多数评测中提升了平均F1分数（HCRL上24/21项通过，ROAD上30/36项通过）。在更贴近现实的ROAD数据集中（攻击重用合法ID），该表示在针对信号操纵攻击（signal-manipulation attacks）的场景下实现了召回率≥0.99，且ROC-AUC较高。此外，论文明确量化了两个局限性：新ID洪泛攻击（HCRL DoS，F1=0.02）和跨ID模糊攻击（ROAD，F1=0.27），从而定义了该表示方法可覆盖的检测边界。该工作适合车载网络安全研究者、CAN入侵检测系统开发人员以及从事异常检测表征学习的从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究直面CAN ID重用攻击这一真实威胁，指出传统基于存在性的检测特征存在盲区，并给出一种不依赖具体检测器即可提升鲁棒性的表示方法，对车端IDS设计与评估具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到其他工业控制或嵌入式网络（如CAN FD、LIN、FlexRay）中基于协议时序与载荷的异常检测场景；有助于改进现有车端IDS对合法ID重用攻击的检测能力。
detection_signals_zh: 当攻击者重用合法仲裁ID时，基于新ID出现的传统特征无法有效检测，需关注每ID内时序/负载/协议特征的残差变化。
特定攻击类型如新ID洪泛（DoS）与跨ID模糊（Fuzzing）仍存在覆盖盲区，检测信号需另行设计。
defense_advice_zh: 在CAN报文监控中引入逐ID行为基线并计算残差，而非仅依赖全局异常特征。
对于已知盲区（如DoS洪泛、跨ID模糊），结合频率限制、DLC校验、物理层信号一致性等补充检测手段。

items.title: Robust Context-Aware Detection of Malicious Instructions in Text
items.summary: The remarkable instruction-following ability of modern LLMs has enabled their practical use as the minds of agents that can autonomously complete increasingly complex tasks. Therein, however, also lies their vulnerability to attacks which embed malicious instructions in text, common variants of which are known as indirect prompt injection (IPI). A fundamental task in addressing this vulnerability is successful segmentation of a given text into benign and malicious sentences (if any). While a number of approaches for this task have been proposed, no detector combines query-relative detection at the segment level, and none are hardened against adaptive evasion attacks realizable in agentic executions. We address the former limitation by developing an approach for malicious sentence classification that is both context- and query-aware. Next, to harden the resulting classifier against evasion, we present two adversarial training methods. The first is directly adapted feature-space adversarial training (AT) in which evasions are approximated using projected-gradient-based optimization in the embedding space. The second simulates realizable evasion attacks in the AT loop through LLM-based paraphrasing. Crucially, we parametrize both AT variants to facilitate a smooth tradeoff between utility and attack robustness. In extensive experiments using indirect prompt injection benchmarks we show that the proposed approach outperforms state-of-the-art IPI defense baselines under static attacks, while in the case of adaptive attacks, our AT variants provide significantly higher utility, lower attack success rate, and often both. Finally, we show that the best AT parameters can depend intimately on the particular application domain. Consequently, domain-dependent tuning of malicious text detectors is likely necessary in practice. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/tavia-liu/CAD.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对现代大语言模型（LLM）在作为智能体自主执行复杂任务时面临的间接提示注入（Indirect Prompt Injection, IPI）攻击威胁，提出了一种健壮的上下文感知恶意指令检测方法。研究指出，缓解此类攻击的基础任务是将给定文本准确分割为良性语句与恶意语句，但现有检测器既未在片段级别实现查询相关的检测，也未针对智能体执行场景中可实现的自适应逃逸攻击进行加固。为此，作者首先开发了一种同时考虑上下文与查询感知的恶意语句分类方法，以解决前一个局限性；随后，为提升分类器对逃逸攻击的鲁棒性，提出了两种对抗训练方法：第一种是直接在特征空间进行对抗训练（AT），通过基于投影梯度的优化在嵌入空间中近似逃逸样本；第二种是在对抗训练循环中通过LLM驱动的改写来模拟实际可实现的逃逸攻击。两种方法均通过参数化设计，实现效用与攻击鲁棒性之间的平滑权衡。在间接提示注入基准测试上的大量实验表明，所提方法在静态攻击下优于最先进的IPI防御基线；在自适应攻击下，对抗训练变体通常能显著提高效用、降低攻击成功率，甚至两者兼得。此外，实验显示最佳的对抗训练参数高度依赖具体应用领域，因此实践中可能需要对恶意文本检测器进行领域相关的调参。论文代码已公开。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM智能体面临间接提示注入这一关键安全威胁，本文提出的上下文感知检测与对抗训练方法为防御者提供了可复用的技术路线，有助于构建更健壮的智能体防护机制。

items.title: Agent Against Agent: An Agentic System for Automatic Prompt Injection Red Teaming
items.summary: Prompt injection poses significant security risks to LLM agents. Efficient and effective red-teaming is therefore critical, both for evaluating these risks and for collecting training data to improve defenses. Existing state-of-the-art prompt injection red-teaming methods primarily rely on reinforcement learning (RL), producing attacker models that often generalize poorly to new target LLMs. In this work, we develop PIMiner, an agentic system for prompt injection red-teaming. During training, PIMiner is trained on a sequence of (dataset, target model) pairs and builds a strategy library from scratch. At test time, the learned strategy library can be directly transferred to a previously unseen target LLM without additional training. PIMiner requires only a small number of queries to a target agent (e.g., 10) per test sample. Experimental results demonstrate that PIMiner achieves strong performance. On IPIArena, it attains a 76.2% ASR against Gemini-2.5-Pro, 61.9% ASR against GPT-5.1, and 42.9% ASR against Claude-Sonnet-4.5. On AgentDojo, it achieves an 86.7% ASR against Gemini-2.5-Pro, 53.3% ASR against GPT-5.1, and 40.0% ASR against Claude-Sonnet-4.5.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对大型语言模型智能体（LLM agents）面临的提示注入（prompt injection）安全风险，提出了一种名为PIMiner的自主智能体系统，用于自动红队测试。现有基于强化学习的红队攻击模型往往在迁移到新目标LLM时泛化能力较差。PIMiner在训练阶段通过对一系列（数据集，目标模型）组合进行训练，从零开始构建一个可复用的策略库。在测试阶段，该策略库可以直接迁移到未见过的目标模型，无需额外训练或微调，并且对每个测试样本仅需少量查询（如10次）。这种设计显著降低了红队测试的成本与门槛。实验在IPIArena和AgentDojo两个基准上进行，结果显示PIMiner在IPIArena上对Gemini-2.5-Pro达到76.2%的攻击成功率（ASR），对GPT-5.1达61.9%，对Claude-Sonnet-4.5达42.9%；在AgentDojo上对应ASR分别为86.7%、53.3%和40.0%。实验证明该方法在攻击成功率与迁移效率上均具有优势。该工作的核心贡献包括：提出一种新颖的智能体化红队框架，构建了可迁移的策略库，以及展示了高效的跨模型攻击性能。对安全社区而言，该研究揭示了提示注入风险的严重性，并为自动生成对抗样本、收集防御训练数据提供了新思路。防御者可以借鉴其策略库思想，强化对多模型场景下注入攻击的检测与防护。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究展示了自动化提示注入红队的新范式，能快速迁移至未见过的大模型，意味着攻击工具化趋势加剧。安全团队需重视此类可迁移攻击对自身Agent系统的威胁，并跟踪后续防御手段。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响面涉及所有基于LLM的Agent应用，尤其是集成外部工具和多步推理的场景。该方法可被用于安全评估工具开发，也可能被恶意行为者借鉴，但论文本身为研究性质。防御方可借此识别自身系统在跨模型攻击下的薄弱环节。

同一会话中多次出现涉及权限提升或敏感操作的异常指令
对目标Agent的查询模式表现出低频率、高针对性的策略性试探
defense_advice_zh: 对输入输出实施双向过滤，识别并阻断明显的注入模式
对Agent的敏感操作实施最小权限原则和人工审批机制
监控Agent行为异常，建立日志审计与告警
定期开展针对多模型场景的红队测试，评估策略库迁移风险

items.title: Hardware Design and Security in the Era of Chiplets and LLMs
items.summary: The semiconductor industry is undergoing a dual revolution: the shift toward heterogeneous 2.5D chiplet systems and the integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into Electronic Design Automation (EDA) flows. While these paradigms offer unprecedented benefits in yield, modularity, design productivity, etc., they radically expand the hardware attack surface. This paper provides a unified analysis of these frontiers, ranging from attacks on chiplet systems (including hardware stacks for LLM acceleration) across architectural, logical, and physical levels, to various exploits against LLM-driven EDA pipelines. To secure chiplet systems, we review a powerful defense approach that leverages 2.5D split manufacturing and active interposers for physically isolated Root of Trust (RoT) architectures. To secure LLM-driven EDA pipelines, we first identify native threats and then review state-of-the-art defense techniques. Finally, we discuss how LLM systems can advance hardware security efforts for modern systems, including chiplets.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对半导体行业正在经历的双重变革——向异构2.5D chiplet系统迁移以及将大型语言模型（LLM）集成到电子设计自动化（EDA）流程中——进行了统一的安全分析。作者指出，虽然这些范式在良率、模块化、设计生产力等方面带来了前所未有的优势，但它们也从根本上扩展了硬件攻击面。论文系统地梳理了针对chiplet系统的攻击，涵盖架构层、逻辑层和物理层，包括针对LLM加速的硬件栈的攻击；同时分析了针对LLM驱动的EDA管线的各种利用方式。在防御方面，论文回顾了一种强大的防御方法：利用2.5D拆分制造和有源中介层（active interposer）构建物理隔离的信任根（Root of Trust, RoT）架构，以保护chiplet系统。对于LLM驱动的EDA管线，作者首先识别了其固有威胁，然后回顾了最先进的防御技术。最后，论文讨论了LLM系统如何能够推进现代硬件安全研究，包括chiplet场景。该论文为硬件安全、EDA和安全交叉领域的研究人员提供了前沿视角，适合关注新兴架构与AI结合带来的安全挑战的读者。

items.title: Gradient Immunity: Null-Space Resistance to Malicious Fine-Tuning
items.summary: Released aligned large language models remain vulnerable to malicious downstream finetuning. Existing defenses are largely designed for the fine-tuning-as-a-service (FTaaS) paradigm or rely on downstream users to follow additional safety procedures, and therefore do not directly address the setting we study: a provider controlled partially protected open-weight (PPOW) release setting in which most weights remain trainable while a small safety-critical component is preserved at release. We propose a Unidirectional Safety Gate (USG), instantiated as a Null Space Cubic Layer together with an Inverse Adapter inserted after the final Transformer layer. During downstream fine-tuning, the cubic layer suppresses or blocks gradients from harmful samples whose hidden states fall in a calibrated protected region, while the Inverse Adapter restores the base model's forward behavior. In practice, we calibrate a threshold using defender-held harmful data, allowing protection to generalize to nearby in-distribution harmful samples. Across six evaluated model-dataset settings, USG keeps post-finetuning attack success rate close to the pre-release level under a fixed release threshold, while maintaining high safe-pass rates on easier settings and exhibiting a clearer safety-utility trade-off on unsafe samples from BeaverTails. These results suggest that release-time representation-space blocking can raise the cost of malicious downstream adaptation without requiring downstream cooperation. The code is available at https://github.com/OpenCausaLab/Gradient-Immunity.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究开放权重大语言模型在发布后被下游恶意微调（malicious fine-tuning）所破坏的问题。现有防御手段大多面向“微调即服务”（FTaaS）范式，或依赖下游用户遵循额外安全协议，并未直接覆盖本文研究的场景：即模型提供方发布“部分受保护开放权重”（PPOW）模型，其中大部分权重保持可训练，但一个安全关键的组件在发布时被保留（不可修改）。为此，作者提出一种单向安全门（Unidirectional Safety Gate, USG），由“零空间三次层”（Null Space Cubic Layer）和插入在最终 Transformer 层之后的“逆适配器”（Inverse Adapter）构成。在下游微调过程中，该三次层会抑制或阻止来自有害样本的梯度传播——这些有害样本的隐藏状态落入预先校准的受保护区域内；而逆适配器则负责恢复基础模型的原始前向行为，从而使模型在正常输入上的表现不受影响。实际使用时，防御方利用自持有的有害数据校准一个阈值，使保护能够泛化到邻近的分布内有害样本。在六个模型-数据集组合上的实验表明，在固定发布阈值下，USG 能将微调后的攻击成功率保持在接近发布前水平，同时在较简单场景中保持较高的“安全通过率”，并在 BeaverTails 不安全样本上展现出更清晰的安全-效用权衡。这些结果说明，在发布时对表示空间进行阻断可以提高下游恶意适配的成本，且无需下游用户配合。适合关注大模型安全、开放权重模型风险管理、对抗性微调防御的研究者与安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 针对开放权重模型被下游恶意微调的现实威胁，提出无需下游配合的发布时防御思路，为模型发布方提供一种可落地的安全控制手段，有助于降低开源模型被武器化的风险。

items.title: Private Direct Preference Optimization for LLM Alignment
items.summary: Direct preference optimization (DPO) is now a standard method for aligning large language models (LLMs) using human preference data. Each DPO example contains a prompt and a pair of candidate model responses. While prompts and responses are often public or model-generated, the relative preference between responses reflects subjective judgments and can reveal sensitive attributes of annotators or end users. Off-the-shelf privacy-preserving approaches are not well matched to this structure, leading to unnecessary noise injection and biased updates in training. In this paper, we formalize preference privacy, a label-DP-style privacy notion for DPO that protects only the relative preference between candidate responses, assuming an adversary who already knows the prompt and responses. We then design PrivDPO, a DPO variant that enforces preference privacy while remaining compatible with large-scale LLM training. Our main observation is that, for neighboring examples differing only in their preference signal, the gradient difference lies on a one-dimensional preference axis determined solely by the text; all preference information flows through this axis. PrivDPO adds calibrated randomness only along this axis via an unbiased randomized rescaling of the DPO objective, avoiding per-example gradient operations. Our experiments on three alignment benchmarks and three LLM families show that PrivDPO consistently achieves strong privacy-utility trade-offs compared with privacy-preserving baselines.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 直接偏好优化（DPO）已成为利用人类偏好数据对齐大语言模型（LLM）的标准方法。每个DPO样本包含一个提示词和一对候选回复，而人类标注者或用户给出的相对偏好往往反映主观判断，可能泄露敏感属性（如政治倾向、健康状态等）。现有隐私保护手段通常采用全局噪声注入或逐样本梯度扰动，既与该数据结构不匹配，也会导致不必要的噪声和训练偏差。本文作者首先形式化了一种名为'偏好隐私'（preference privacy）的隐私概念，它采用类似标签差分隐私（label-DP）的风格，只保护候选回复之间的相对偏好信号，并假设攻击者已经知道提示词和回复本身。基于这一概念，他们设计了PrivDPO——一种与大规模LLM训练兼容的DPO变体。关键观察是：对于仅在偏好信号上不同的相邻样本，它们的梯度差异落在一个由文本唯一决定的一维'偏好轴'上，所有偏好信息都流经此轴。因此，PrivDPO只沿着这一维度添加经过校准的随机性，通过对DPO目标进行无偏的随机重缩放来实现，从而避免了逐样本梯度操作，显著降低了计算开销和噪声干扰。作者在三个对齐基准和三个LLM家族上进行了实验，结果表明与现有隐私保护基线相比，PrivDPO在隐私-效用权衡上持续表现更优。总的来说，该工作为LLM对齐过程中的偏好隐私保护提供了一个理论基础扎实且可扩展的解决方案，对推动隐私友好的模型训练具有重要价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究解决了LLM对齐中偏好数据隐私保护不足的问题，为依赖人类反馈的模型训练提供了可证明的隐私保证，有助于减少敏感信息泄露风险，对隐私合规和可信AI有重要实践意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于需要利用人类偏好数据进行模型对齐的场景，如RLHF/DPO流程中的隐私保护；也可迁移到其他基于成对偏好学习的任务（如排序、推荐）中。目前仍处于研究阶段，尚未形成直接攻击检测信号。
defense_advice_zh: 在采用DPO或RLHF对齐模型时，应评估偏好数据的敏感程度，考虑引入类似PrivDPO的偏好隐私保护机制。
对数据标注流程进行隐私影响分析，明确标注者信息与偏好信号的关联边界。

items.title: LLM-Assisted Detection and Repair of Hardware Security Vulnerabilities in Verilog Designs
items.summary: Hardware designs, like software, are susceptible to bugs that can introduce security vulnerabilities and create opportunities for malicious exploitation. Unlike software vulnerabilities, however, hardware flaws become permanently embedded in silicon after fabrication, making them difficult or impossible to patch. Many of these weaknesses are categorized under the Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) framework and include improper access control, exposure of sensitive information, and unintended privilege escalation. To improve the detection of such vulnerabilities, we propose a methodology that leverages a Large Language Model (LLM) to identify potential hardware CWEs directly from hardware designs in Verilog. The proposed approach is evaluated iteratively on a dataset of single-module Verilog designs to assess its effectiveness in detecting hardware security weaknesses. Our results demonstrate the potential of LLMs to augment traditional hardware security analysis by providing automated, scalable assistance for identifying security vulnerabilities during the hardware design process.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对硬件设计（Verilog）中的安全漏洞检测问题，提出了一种利用大语言模型（LLM）自动识别硬件常见弱点枚举（CWE）的方法。硬件设计如同软件一样存在缺陷，可能引入安全漏洞并导致恶意利用；但与软件漏洞不同，硬件缺陷在流片后永久固化于硅片中，极难或无法修复。论文指出，许多此类弱点属于CWE框架范畴，如不当访问控制、敏感信息暴露、非预期权限提升等。为改进检测，作者提出一种方法论：直接使用LLM分析Verilog硬件设计代码，从中识别潜在的硬件CWE。该方法在单模块Verilog设计数据集上进行了迭代评估，以检验其检测硬件安全弱点的有效性。实验结果表明，LLM在自动化、可扩展地辅助硬件安全分析方面具有潜力，能够在硬件设计流程中及时识别安全漏洞，从而增强传统硬件安全分析方法。论文主要贡献在于探索LLM在硬件安全检测领域的应用，为硬件设计阶段的安全验证提供了新的自动化思路。适合硬件安全研究人员、EDA工具开发者及芯片设计流程中的安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 硬件漏洞难以修复，事后发现成本极高；LLM辅助检测可在设计阶段提前识别CWE，提升安全左移能力，值得硬件安全与EDA团队关注。

items.title: "Allow" to Achieve, Over-Privileged Inadvertently: The Unintended Cost of Task-Completion-Driven Pop-up Decisions in Mobile GUI Agents
items.summary: Mobile GUI agents routinely encounter system permission dialogs during task execution, yet their ability to grant only permissions that are necessary for the delegated task remains largely unexamined. We present a systematic study of this capability, which we term Permission Literacy. We construct a four-level permission framework based on task relevance and privacy risk and validate the evaluated scenarios with three independent experts in GUI-agent safety. We inject Android-style permission popups into real GUI tasks and evaluate four frontier multimodal large language models using synchronized annotated screenshots and UI-tree hierarchies, making the requester, permission, justification, and available actions accessible to the agent. Beyond the main study, we conduct controlled interventions that separately vary task context and agent-visible requester identity. Under the same Calendar task, changing only the requester from Calendar to PiMusic reduces grants from 26/32 to 0/32, revealing a strong but task-conditioned App-Trust Bias. Holding a popup fixed while changing task context also substantially changes authorization decisions, revealing a systematic Task-Prior Override. Prompt interventions can reduce unnecessary grants, but their effectiveness is inconsistent across models and may come at the cost of suppressing legitimate grants. These results suggest that separating task execution from permission authorization is a promising design direction for future work.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文系统研究了移动GUI代理在任务执行过程中面对系统权限弹窗时的授权行为，重点关注其是否能够仅授予任务所必需的权限，作者将此能力定义为“权限素养”。研究构建了一个基于任务相关性与隐私风险的四级权限框架，并通过三名GUI代理安全领域专家验证了评估场景的合理性。实验采用注入Android风格权限弹窗的方式，结合同步标注截图与UI树层次，将请求者、权限、理由及可用操作均暴露给代理，评估了四个前沿多模态大语言模型。主研究之外，作者还进行了受控干预实验，分别改变任务上下文和代理可见的请求者身份。结果显示，在相同的日历任务下，仅将请求者从Calendar替换为PiMusic，授权数量就从26/32骤降至0/32，揭示了强烈的、受任务条件约束的“应用信任偏见”。同时，在保持弹窗不变而改变任务上下文时，授权决策同样发生显著变化，表明存在系统性的“任务优先覆盖”现象。提示干预可以降低不必要的授权，但效果在模型中不一致，且可能以抑制合法授权为代价。作者据此提出，将任务执行与权限授权分离是未来设计的一个有前景的方向。该研究首次系统性地刻画了移动GUI代理的权限授予行为，提出了新的概念和分析框架，为AI代理安全领域提供了重要实证依据。适合AI安全、自主代理设计、人机交互安全方向的研究人员和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 移动GUI代理正被部署于真实场景，若其过度授权权限，可能造成敏感数据泄露或未授权操作。蓝队需了解这些行为偏差，以便设计审计与防护机制。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有基于LLM的自动化代理（如手机助手、RPA）的权限管理设计，也可迁移到云API代理的细粒度授权场景。
defense_advice_zh: 部署代理时强制区分任务执行与权限授权流程，独立审批关键权限。
对代理发出的每一个授权请求记录上下文，建立基线以识别异常授权行为。
限制代理可访问的敏感权限，实施最小权限原则，并定期审查授权日志。

items.title: Towards a Risk Assessment of Malicious Skill Files in Coding Agents
items.summary: Autonomous coding agents are increasingly embedded in enterprise software workflows with delegated authority over connected systems. Central to this architecture is the agent skills interface: folders of instructions and scripts that agents load dynamically to specialize their behavior. This interface also widens the attack surface, letting malicious shell commands hide within natural-language skill files. We make three contributions. First, an adversarial skill-synthesis method using six LLMs across four families to transform 471 real-world shell commands into benign-appearing skills, released as a benchmark of 2,826 skills mapped to 11 MITRE ATT&CK tactics. Second, a reproducible evaluation pipeline coupling run stratification, evidence anchoring, a refusal veto, and a deterministic declared-intent override with a three-judge LLM-as-a-judge panel, validated against a blind human gold standard (Cohen's kappa = 0.85). Third, a large-scale characterization of two enterprise-grade agents across 5,629 completed runs. Gemini CLI is exploited in 95.5-96.1% of runs and Qwen Code in 71.6-74.0% (raw majority vote to declared-intent-corrected estimate, both within the human gold standard), nearly invariant to the generating model. Explicit safety recognition occurs in only 1.99% of runs. Enterprises must assess and mitigate skill-interface risk before adopting coding agents. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/awsm-research/AgentJailbreak

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对自主编码智能体（coding agents）在进入企业软件工作流后所引入的新型安全风险进行了系统性研究。这类智能体通常被授予对连接系统的委派权限，其核心架构依赖“技能接口”（agent skills interface），即以文件夹形式存储的指令和脚本，智能体在运行时动态加载以完成特定任务。然而，这一接口也显著扩大了攻击面：恶意shell命令可以隐藏在看似无害的自然语言技能文件中，从而绕过传统安全检测。研究团队提出了三项主要贡献。第一，提出一种对抗性技能合成方法，利用来自四个系列的六种大型语言模型（LLMs），将471条真实世界shell命令转化为外观良性的恶意技能文件，构建了包含2826个技能样本的基准数据集，并映射到11种MITRE ATT&CK战术。第二，构建了一个可复现的评估流水线，包含运行分层、证据锚定、拒绝否决和确定性声明意图覆盖机制，并采用三人LLM评审团（LLM-as-a-judge）进行裁决；通过与人类盲审金标准（Cohen's kappa = 0.85）对比验证了该流水线的可靠性。第三，对两款企业级智能体（Gemini CLI和Qwen Code）进行了大规模实证评估，覆盖5629次完整运行。结果显示，Gemini CLI在95.5%-96.1%的运行中被成功利用，Qwen Code在71.6%-74.0%的运行中被利用（数值范围从原始多数投票到声明意图修正估计，均与人类金标准相符），且利用成功率几乎不受生成模型的影响。此外，显式安全识别率仅为1.99%，表明现有模型对恶意技能文件的防护能力严重不足。作者强调，企业在采用编码智能体之前，必须评估并缓解技能接口风险。代码和数据集已在GitHub上公开。本文适合安全研究人员、AI红队、DevSecOps工程师以及企业安全决策者阅读，以理解编码智能体供应链中的新型攻击面与评估方法论。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 编码智能体正被企业广泛采用，其技能接口可作为隐蔽攻击通道，使恶意指令绕过传统安全控制。本研究首次大规模量化了这一风险，提供可复现的评估方法，对安全审计和智能体供应链安全具有重要意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用编码智能体的企业，尤其是通过技能文件扩展智能体功能的场景。攻击者可投递恶意技能文件实现任意命令执行、数据窃取或持久化，且现有模型缺乏有效识别能力。
detection_signals_zh: 技能文件中包含可疑的shell命令或混淆脚本
智能体运行时出现异常的系统调用或网络连接
技能文件来源不可信或未经过安全审查
defense_advice_zh: 对技能文件实施严格的访问控制和内容审查，建立可信技能库
在智能体运行时实施最小权限原则，限制对敏感系统和数据的访问
部署监测机制，检测智能体执行过程中的异常行为
对已有技能进行安全扫描，识别潜在恶意模式

items.title: Checked-In Secret Detection: Strings Are All You Need
items.summary: Hardcoded secrets in source code pose critical security vulnerabilities which can be easily exploited by malicious adversaries. Existing regex-based detection approaches suffer from fundamental limitations, as secrets often lack identifiable patterns, resulting in poor precision and recall. Recent studies have explored context-aware detection methods, as surrounding code can reveal the purpose of candidate strings. However, these methods confront three key challenges: (1) obfuscation robustness where models over-rely on easily obfuscated identifiers, (2) cross-language generalization difficulties due to uneven training data distribution, and (3) lengthy and noisy context that introduces excessive irrelevant tokens and slows inference. We observe that strings serve as a critical information source for code semantics, offering superior contextual density, obfuscation robustness, and language independence. Based on this insight, we propose StringGroup, a novel context extraction algorithm that mines strings surrounding potential secrets. By introducing a relatively simple modification to existing patterns that narrows the analysis specifically to string literals, the method achieves significant gains. With only 33.2% of the original context, it preserves over 80% of semantic information and significantly improves the signal-to-noise ratio for secret detection. We further design a context-aware secret detection tool, Secretron, based on StringGroup methods and Transformer model. Evaluation on the SecretBench dataset demonstrates high accuracy with 98.74% F1-score and strong robustness under obfuscation and cross-language scenarios, outperforming state-of-the-art LLM-based baselines. We deploy our tool in real-world environments and successfully detect 48 previously unknown secret keys from 26 applications, demonstrating the practical effectiveness of our approach.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对源代码中硬编码密钥（hardcoded secrets）这一严重安全漏洞展开研究。现有基于正则表达式的检测方法因密钥往往缺乏可识别模式而存在精度和召回率低下的根本性局限。近期研究尝试利用上下文感知检测，通过分析候选字符串周围的代码来推断其用途，但仍面临三大挑战：一是混淆鲁棒性不足，模型过度依赖容易被混淆的标识符；二是跨语言泛化困难，训练数据分布不均导致效果不稳定；三是上下文长而嘈杂，引入大量无关标记并拖慢推理速度。论文作者观察到字符串本身是代码语义的关键信息源，具有更高的上下文密度、更强的混淆鲁棒性和更好的语言无关性。基于这一洞见，他们提出名为 StringGroup 的新型上下文提取算法，专门挖掘潜在密钥周围的字符串字面量。通过对现有模式进行相对简单的修改，将分析范围聚焦于字符串字面量，方法在仅使用原始上下文 33.2% 的情况下保留了超过 80% 的语义信息，显著提高了密钥检测的信噪比。作者进一步基于 StringGroup 方法和 Transformer 模型设计了上下文感知的密钥检测工具 Secretron。在 SecretBench 数据集上的评估显示，该工具实现了 98.74% 的 F1 分数，并在混淆和跨语言场景下表现出强鲁棒性，优于当前最先进的基于 LLM 的基线方法。此外，作者已在真实环境中部署该工具，成功从 26 个应用中检测出 48 个先前未知的密钥，验证了其实用有效性。该研究为代码安全审计中的敏感信息泄露检测提供了高效且可落地的解决方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 硬编码密钥是真实且高发的安全风险，现有检测工具精度有限。该研究提出基于字符串上下文的高效检测方法，用更少上下文获得更高准确率，且兼顾混淆鲁棒性与跨语言能力，对蓝队自动化审计代码仓库中的敏感信息泄露有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于 CI/CD 流水线、代码仓库扫描、云密钥泄露防护等场景，尤其适合大型多语言仓库中的密钥检测与分类，能有效降低误报和漏报。

items.title: Large Language Models and Social Media Information Integrity: Opportunities, Challenges, and Research Directions
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools that impact information integrity on social media platforms. This comprehensive review examines the dual role of LLMs in both facilitating and mitigating various information integrity challenges, including misinformation, disinformation, fake news, social bots, and privacy concerns. \textcolor{black}{We conduct a comprehensive review of the literature from 2019 to 2024, screening 1048 studies and performing an in-depth analysis of 215 representative papers. This systematic approach allows us to identify key patterns in how LLMs influence the information security in social media ecosystems.} Through a systematic analysis of papers from multiple databases, our findings reveal that while LLMs can enhance detection capabilities for malicious content and enable sophisticated defense mechanisms, they simultaneously pose risks by enabling the generation of highly convincing, deceptive content. We categorize and analyze the potential and challenges across different dimensions of information integrity, examining technical capabilities, ethical implications, and privacy concerns. The study demonstrates critical gaps in current approaches, particularly in cross-lingual detection, real-time monitoring, and privacy-preserving implementations. We conclude by proposing future research directions and recommendations for stakeholders to leverage LLMs while mitigating risks in social media information integrity.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文是一篇关于大语言模型（LLM）与社交媒体信息完整性关系的系统性综述，发表于2024年，作者团队来自多所高校。研究背景是：LLM在社交媒体平台上的广泛应用既可能加剧虚假信息、深度伪造、社交机器人等威胁，也为检测和防御提供了新工具。核心问题是：LLM究竟如何双向影响信息完整性？当前技术存在哪些缺口？未来应如何发展？作者采用系统性文献综述方法，筛选了2019至2024年间1048项研究，并对其中215篇代表性论文进行深入分析，覆盖多个学术数据库。研究发现：一方面，LLM显著增强了恶意内容检测、自动化事实核查和对抗性防御的能力；另一方面，LLM也能被用来生成高度逼真且具有欺骗性的内容，从而放大虚假信息、操纵舆论、侵犯隐私。文章将信息完整性挑战划分为多个维度，包括错误信息、虚假信息、假新闻、社交机器人和隐私问题，分别梳理了LLM带来的机遇与风险，并讨论了技术能力、伦理影响和隐私关切。此外，作者明确指出当前方法存在三大关键缺口：跨语言检测能力不足、实时监控机制薄弱、隐私保护实现缺失。最后，论文提出了未来研究方向，并为平台方、政策制定者和技术社区提供了平衡利用LLM与降低风险的初步建议。适合关注AI安全、社交媒体治理、虚假信息检测的研究人员、安全分析师和平台治理从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM正在重塑社交媒体信息生态，蓝队需要理解其双重性：既可用于自动化防御，也可能被攻击者滥用生成虚假内容。本文系统梳理了攻防全景和已知缺口，为安全团队规划检测策略和风险评估提供参考。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响社交媒体平台的信息完整性防护体系，包括虚假信息检测、社交机器人识别、隐私保护等场景；对安全运营中涉及内容分析、异常账号检测的团队具有迁移参考价值。

items.title: Behavioral Skill Reconstruction: Reconstructing Hidden Functionality from LLM Agent Skills
items.summary: Closed source agent skills may encode proprietary instructions, scripts, constants, and data. Providers may offer their capabilities as services while keeping the underlying packages hidden. Prior work focuses on prompt injection attacks that directly disclose these artifacts, and existing defenses accordingly aim to prevent such leakage. However, preventing file disclosure does not prevent users from recovering the functionality those files implement. This raises a fundamental question: can a user reconstruct a skill's functionality through ordinary use while its files remain hidden? We study behavioral skill reconstruction (BSR), in which an attacker uses valid task requests and observed responses to build a functional clone of a hidden skill. We introduce SkillClone, a black-box attack that clones a target skill by forming an interface hypothesis from its public advertisement, issuing structured benign probes, synthesizing an executable replica, and iteratively repairing it through differential validation against the victim skill. Across 30 skills spanning rules, tables, procedures, and algorithms, SkillClone achieves exact or partial recovery on held-out inputs for several targets. Iterative requerying closes gaps missed by single-round reconstruction. Because SkillClone uses only legitimate interactions, disclosure-focused defenses provide limited coverage, and less detailed skill descriptions offer limited protection. These results show that file secrecy alone does not ensure functional secrecy. Defenses must also limit cumulative information leakage from ordinary use.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了一种针对 LLM Agent 技能（skill）的新型攻击范式——行为技能重建（Behavioral Skill Reconstruction, BSR）。在云服务或封闭式 API 场景中，服务提供商可能将专有指令、脚本、常量或数据封装为隐藏的技能包，仅向用户开放调用接口，而用户无法直接读取底层文件。以往攻击主要依赖提示注入（prompt injection）来直接泄露这些文件，防御方也相应加强了对直接泄露的检测与阻断。然而，本文指出：即使阻止文件泄露，用户仍可能通过正常使用技能来恢复其实现的功能。为此，作者提出了一种黑盒攻击方法 SkillClone，其核心流程包括：1）根据技能的公开广告信息建立接口假设；2）发送结构化的良性探测请求；3）基于观察到的响应合成一个可执行的功能克隆；4）与被攻击的原始技能进行差分验证，并迭代修复克隆体。作者在 30 个涵盖规则、表格、流程和算法等类型的技能上进行了实验，结果显示 SkillClone 在保留测试集上对多个目标实现了完全或部分恢复，且迭代重查能够弥补单轮重建的遗漏。由于该方法仅使用合法交互，现有的基于防御泄露的机制覆盖有限，而较模糊的技能描述也只能提供十分有限的保护。研究表明，文件保密性并不等同于功能保密性，防御方必须关注普通使用过程中的累积信息泄露。对于 LLM Agent 生态的安全设计者、API 提供方和安全研究者而言，该工作揭示了封闭模型服务中隐藏功能可被逆向复现的现实风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究打破了“隐藏文件即可保护功能”的假设，证明仅通过正常使用即可重建专有技能，对依赖保密实现来保护知识产权的 LLM Agent 服务构成实际威胁，促使防御方重新思考信息暴露边界。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有以黑盒 API 形式提供 LLM Agent 技能的服务商，尤其是将专有算法、规则或数据作为核心竞争力的场景；也可能适用于模型即服务（MaaS）中可观察到的行为逆向工程。
detection_signals_zh: 重复且结构化的良性请求序列，符合差分验证模式
用户在同一时间段内对同一技能发送大量类似输入并对比输出
请求参数包含边界值或覆盖表格/规则分支的枚举模式
defense_advice_zh: 限制单一用户对技能的高频访问和输出差分能力
对输出做聚合扰动或添加不改变功能的微小噪声，防止精确重建
对技能调用实施异常检测，识别针对特定技能的探测行为
定期评估技能在长期交互中的累积信息泄露风险

items.title: A Security-Oriented Lifecycle Model for Large Language Model Systems
items.summary: Large language models are being integrated into critical infrastructure and enterprise workflows at unprecedented scale,yet the lifecycle frameworks governing their development and operations were designed for operational efficiency rather than security analysis. As a result, security-relevant activities such as data provenance verification, artifact signing, agentic permission control, and decommissioning are often left implicit or assumed to receive due care. Governance frameworks, in turn, organise requirements around risk levels or management processes without clearly linking them to the lifecycle stages where they apply. This paper addresses both deficiencies. We propose a lifecycle model for LLM systems that supports security analysis by structuring it around security-relevant boundaries rather than workflow optimisation. The model comprises 32 stages across four core pipeline layers (Data, Model, Distribution, Application), supported by a 12-stage LLMOps pillar and a 9-category governance pillar. Thirteen stages are introduced here as separate units because they expose distinct security concerns that existing frameworks do not clearly distinguish. A governance mapping synthesising the NIST AI RMF, the EU AI Act, and ISO/IEC 42001 reveals a structural property of the current regulatory landscape: governance evidence concentrates at deployment-facing stages, where systems are visible to regulators, while the most consequential decisions, data selection, alignment strategy, and capability boundaries, are made at development-facing stages, where regulatory visibility is lowest.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种面向安全分析的大型语言模型（LLM）系统生命周期模型。当前，LLM 正以前所未有的规模被集成到关键基础设施和企业工作流中，但现有生命周期框架主要针对运营效率设计，缺乏对安全分析的支持。因此，数据来源验证、工件签名、智能体权限控制、退役处理等安全相关活动往往被隐式处理或假定会得到适当关注。同时，治理框架通常按风险级别或管理流程组织要求，却未清晰地将这些要求与它们适用的生命周期阶段相关联。本文针对这两个缺陷，提出了一种以安全相关边界而非工作流优化为核心结构的 LLM 系统生命周期模型。该模型包含四个核心流水线层（数据、模型、分发、应用）中的 32 个阶段，并辅以包含 12 个阶段的 LLMOps 支柱和包含 9 个类别的治理支柱。其中，有 13 个阶段被单独引入，因为它们暴露了现有框架未明确区分的不同安全关注点。此外，作者综合了 NIST AI RMF、欧盟《人工智能法案》和 ISO/IEC 42001，构建了一个治理映射关系，揭示了当前监管格局的结构性特征：治理证据集中在面向部署的阶段（系统对监管者可见），而最关键的决策——数据选择、对齐策略和能力边界——发生在面向开发的阶段，而该阶段监管可见性最低。本文的主要贡献包括：提出了一个支持安全分析的 LLM 生命周期模型，明确了现有框架中被忽略的安全相关阶段，并通过治理映射指出了监管覆盖中的不对称性。适合 LLM 系统开发者、安全架构师、AI 治理合规人员以及关注 LLM 供应链安全的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该生命周期模型为 LLM 系统的安全分析提供了结构化框架，有助于识别现有治理盲区（如开发阶段监管缺失），对安全团队评估 LLM 供应链风险、制定覆盖全生命周期的安全策略具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可为 LLM 系统开发与运维提供安全生命周期参考，影响面包括企业 LLM 集成、AI 治理合规、智能体权限管理、模型供应链安全等场景。
