items.title: The Trust-Free Aggregation Layer of the Unicity Infrastructure
items.summary: Unicity is a novel blockchain infrastructure for enabling users to execute off-chain peer-to-peer token transactions while preventing parallel states of tokens (double-spending) with minimal blockchain complexity and storage. A key component of the infrastructure is the Aggregation Layer responsible for storing information about the spent states of tokens and providing compact cryptographic proofs of no double-spending for the users without making any compromises in trust. Aggregation Layer is a layer 2 style service that holds an append-only key-value repository that periodically certifies its state using a traditional blockchain that we call the Consensus Layer. Every time while certifying a changed state the Aggregation Layer provides a cryptographic proof to the Consensus Layer about the append-only consistency of the key-value store. We use the Radix Sparse Merkle Trees (RSMTs) to create the cryptographic digest r_i of the store in every round i and authentication paths of special type in order to prove that the next digest r_{i+1} was obtained while only adding some key-value pairs (k,v) to the repository. The proof verification code is implemented as an Algebraic Intermediate Representation (AIR) circuit on top of the Plonky3 STARK toolkit. Our implementation uses no trusted setup, achieves throughput of 10,000 insertions per second and and millisecond range verification time on a single consumer-class CPU.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出并实现了一种名为 Unicity 的新型区块链基础设施，其核心目标是支持用户进行链下点对点代币交易，同时以极低的区块链复杂度和存储开销防止代币的并行状态（即双花问题）。Unicity 的关键组件是聚合层（Aggregation Layer），它是一个类似 Layer 2 的服务，维护一个仅追加的键值仓库，并周期性地通过传统区块链（称为共识层）对自身状态进行认证。聚合层在每次状态变更时，向共识层提供密码学证明，证明键值仓库的追加一致性。具体而言，作者使用 Radix 稀疏默克尔树（RSMTs）在每一轮生成仓库的摘要 r_i，并利用特殊类型的认证路径证明下一轮摘要 r_{i+1} 仅通过向仓库中添加若干键值对 (k,v) 获得。该证明验证代码被实现为 Plonky3 STARK 工具包之上的代数中间表示（AIR）电路。实现无需可信设置，在单个消费级 CPU 上可实现每秒 10,000 次插入的吞吐量和毫秒级验证时间。该研究解决了区块链系统中去信任聚合的技术难题，为轻量级、可扩展的双花防护提供了新的架构思路。适合对区块链扩展性、密码学累加器、STARK 证明系统以及 Layer 2 设计感兴趣的网络安全和分布式系统研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文提出一种无需可信第三方的链下交易防双花方案，利用 RSMT 和 STARK 证明实现高效验证，对设计可扩展、低成本的区块链 Layer 2 基础设施具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可能影响区块链支付通道、去中心化金融（DeFi）资产转移、以及需要高频小体积交易的场景，为轻量级防双花机制提供新选择。

items.title: eMicro: Real-Time Multi-Hop Access Control for Microservices with eBPF
items.summary: Modern cloud applications often comprise thousands of microservices whose interactions form complex request paths. Traditional inter-service access control restricts individual service-to-service requests, but fails to prevent multi-hop attacks, where each hop appears legitimate yet the overall path violates security intent. This gap leaves systems exposed to unauthorized access and data exfiltration. In this paper, we present eMicro, a path-aware defense system for microservices that prevents such attacks while remaining efficient and deployable. eMicro enforces real-time multi-hop access control through three key techniques: (1) history-based access control extended to capture service invocation sequences; (2) security policies encoded as efficient deterministic finite automaton (DFA), supporting constant-time lookups and compact label propagation; (3) eBPF-based in-kernel request tracing for transparent, low-overhead enforcement without code changes. Evaluations on DeathStarBench and production cloud traces from Uber, Alibaba, and ByteDance, covering 12 million request workflows and thousands of services, demonstrate the scalability of eMicro. eMicro performs policy checks in 1 microsecond, stores 50 million policies in only 100 MB, and reduces propagation overhead by 90% with negligible runtime impact. These results show that eMicro delivers scalable and efficient protection against multi-hop attacks, making it practical for deployment in large-scale microservice environments.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 现代云应用通常由数千个微服务组成，其交互形成复杂的请求路径。传统的服务间访问控制仅限制单个服务到服务的请求，无法防止多跳攻击，即每一跳请求看似合法，但整体路径违反安全意图。这种缺陷使系统面临未授权访问和数据泄露风险。本文提出eMicro，一种面向微服务的路径感知防御系统，旨在高效且可部署地防止此类攻击。eMicro通过三项关键技术实施实时的多跳访问控制：(1) 基于历史的访问控制扩展，以捕获服务调用序列；(2) 将安全策略编码为高效确定性有限自动机（DFA），支持常数时间查找和紧凑标签传播；(3) 基于eBPF的内核请求跟踪，实现透明、低开销的强制措施，无需修改代码。在DeathStarBench以及来自Uber、阿里和字节跳动的生产云追踪数据上进行的评估，覆盖1200万条请求工作流和数千个服务，证明了eMicro的可扩展性。eMicro在1微秒内执行策略检查，仅用100 MB存储5000万条策略，并将传播开销降低90%，运行时影响可忽略不计。这些结果表明，eMicro能提供可扩展、高效的防护以抵御多跳攻击，使其适合部署于大规模微服务环境。该研究为微服务安全领域的路径感知访问控制提供了新的实现思路，并通过大规模实验验证了其实用性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 多跳攻击在微服务架构中常被忽视，传统单跳访问控制难以识别。eMicro提出路径感知的实时强制方法，利用eBPF实现低开销，并在大规模生产数据上验证可行性，为云原生安全提供了一种可落地的防御思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于大规模微服务环境、云原生基础设施和零信任架构，可增强对内部横向移动和数据泄露的防护能力。
defense_advice_zh: 评估现有微服务访问控制策略，识别多跳路径风险点。
关注eBPF技术在内核层实施低开销监控的可行性。
考虑将路径感知访问控制纳入微服务安全架构设计。

items.title: Kerckhoffs-Compliant Watermarking for Physical Design IP Protection: From Placement to Routing
items.summary: Physical design (PD) intellectual property (IP) is a valuable artifact of modern VLSI implementation. It includes optimized cell placement, clock distribution, and routing decisions produced by carefully tuned PD flows. As access to PD tools expands, unauthorized reuse of placed-and-routed databases becomes an increasing concern. Existing PD watermarking methods either protect only one PD stage or rely on hidden construction details, leaving them vulnerable to a white-box adversary. In this work, we develop PDMarks, a Kerckhoffs-compliant watermarking framework whose security depends only on a secret key. PDMarks embeds ownership evidence across multiple stages of the PD flow, including placement, clock tree synthesis (CTS), and routing. All watermark instances and target values are deterministically derived from a 32-byte secret key using HMAC-SHA256, enabling consistent embedding and verification. PDMarks has been integrated into OpenROAD-flow-scripts. Experiments on NanGate45 and ASAP7 designs show that PDMarks outperforms prior physical design watermarking methods by providing much stronger ownership evidence with comparable or smaller PPA overhead. The approximate joint all-stage coincidence probability is below 10^{-32} for every evaluated design. Wrong-key and attack evaluations further show that incorrect keys do not reproduce the complete ownership proof and that weakening the watermark requires broad perturbation of the protected implementation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出 PDMarks，一个符合 Kerckhoffs 原则的物理设计（PD）知识产权（IP）水印框架，用于保护现代 VLSI 实现中的版图设计资产。物理设计 IP 包括经过精心调优的布局、时钟树综合（CTS）和布线决策，随着 PD 工具访问的普及，未授权重用已布局布线数据库的风险日益增加。现有方法要么只保护单一设计阶段，要么依赖隐藏的构造细节，无法对抗白盒攻击者。PDMarks 的安全性仅依赖于一个 32 字节的密钥，通过 HMAC-SHA256 从密钥确定性派生所有水印实例和目标值，从而实现在布局、CTS 和布线等多个阶段的鲁棒水印嵌入与验证。该框架已集成到 OpenROAD-flow-scripts 中，并在 NanGate45 和 ASAP7 设计上进行了实验。结果表明，与先前的物理设计水印方法相比，PDMarks 能提供更强的所有权证据，同时保持相当或更小的功耗、性能和面积（PPA）开销。在所有评估的设计中，近似联合全阶段巧合概率低于 10^{-32}。错误密钥和攻击评估显示，错误密钥无法重现完整的所有权证明，而削弱水印需要对受保护实现进行大范围扰动。该研究的主要贡献包括：提出首个跨多个 PD 阶段的、符合 Kerckhoffs 原则的水印框架；集成到开源工具链；通过严格的概率和实验验证了其鲁棒性和低开销。适合硬件安全、芯片设计 IP 保护及 EDA 工具链开发者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究填补了物理设计 IP 水印在对抗白盒攻击和跨阶段保护方面的空白，为芯片设计团队提供了一种合规且可验证的所有权证明方案，有助于防范未授权重用。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响半导体 IP 保护、EDA 工具安全设计流程，可迁移至类似的多阶段数字资产确权场景（如 FPGA 设计、硬件木马溯源）。

items.title: When Do PEFT Adaptations Leak Structure? Measuring Black-Box Structural Bounds in Public-Base Model Services
items.summary: Services increasingly deploy public foundation models with private parameter-efficient adaptations, creating a differential information leakage risk when auditors or adversaries can execute the public base model locally and observe victim outputs. We present VectorHijack-SR, a measurement methodology that converts paired victim/base residuals into calibrated structural bounds over PEFT family, layer locality, and coarse rank, while separating metadata visibility from open-world validity and operational exploitability. Our estimator aggregates query-level magnitude, ranking, entropy, margin, length, template, locality, and spectral statistics into service-level representations. A service-disjoint classifier quantifies structural evidence, and a cross-fitted hierarchical rejector evaluates whether a victim lies outside the calibrated LoRA manifold. Across classification backbones, family leakage exceeds uniform chance on BERT/MNLI (8/12), RoBERTa/MNLI (21/24), and DeBERTa-v3 on MNLI (12/18) and AG News (15/18). Rank inference is task dependent: BERT/MNLI and DeBERTa/AG News reach 8/9, whereas DeBERTa/MNLI achieves 4/9 and is statistically compatible with chance after correction. On a ten-seed BERT open-set grid, the rejector achieves pooled AUROC 0.804 (95% CI [0.660, 0.927]) and known accuracy 0.956, but remains limited on structurally close DoRA and LoRA+head variants. Exact-version linkage on five held-out LoRA-r64 services reaches AUC 0.940. Experiments reveal a visibility-exploitability gap: two-stage recovery provides no fair-budget query savings, posterior-selected PEFT underperforms distill-then-convert PEFT (0.356 vs. 0.517), and free-running generation remains near chance. These results show that known-base, rich-output PEFT services can leak actionable structural and version information, while closed-set confidence alone does not establish universal adapter recovery.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究的是：当公共基础模型（如BERT、RoBERTa、DeBERTa-v3）被部署为服务，并叠加了私有的参数高效微调（PEFT）适配器（如LoRA）时，攻击者或审计者如果能在本地运行公共基础模型并观察到受害服务的输出，就可能产生一种差异化信息泄露风险。作者提出了一种称为 VectorHijack-SR 的测量方法，将成对的受害服务输出与本地基础模型输出之间的残差转换为经过校准的结构性边界估计，从而推断PEFT家族的类别、层局部性和粗略秩。该方法聚合了查询级别的幅值、排名、熵、边际、长度、模板、局部性和频谱统计量，形成服务级表示；使用服务不相交的分类器来量化结构性证据，并使用交叉拟合的层次拒绝器来评估受害服务是否位于校准的LoRA流形之外。实验表明：在分类骨干网络上，家族泄露超过均匀随机的概率在BERT/MNLI上为8/12，RoBERTa/MNLI为21/24，DeBERTa-v3在MNLI上为12/18、在AG News上为15/18。秩推断是任务依赖的：BERT/MNLI和DeBERTa/AG News达到8/9，而DeBERTa/MNLI只有4/9，且在统计上与随机一致。在十种子BERT开放集网格上，拒绝器达到池化AUROC 0.804（95% CI [0.660, 0.927]）和已知精度0.956，但在结构上接近的DoRA和LoRA+头变体上表现有限。对五个保留的LoRA-r64服务，精确版本关联达到AUC 0.940。实验还揭示了可见性与可利用性之间的差距：两阶段恢复没有带来公平预算下的查询节省，后验选择的PEFT性能差于先蒸馏再转换的PEFT（0.356 vs 0.517），自由运行生成接近随机。这些结果表明，已知基础模型、输出丰富的PEFT服务可能泄露可操作的结构和版本信息，但仅凭封闭集置信度并不能保证通用的适配器恢复。本文的贡献在于提出一种新的测量方法论，系统量化了PEFT适配器泄露的结构边界，并揭示了不同条件下的泄露程度和限制，为服务提供商和防御者提供了评估此类风险的工具。适合关注机器学习服务安全性、模型知识产权保护和隐私泄露的研究人员、安全工程师和平台运营者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了基于公共基础模型加私有PEFT的服务存在结构性泄露风险，可帮助防御者评估自身服务是否容易被推断出微调家族和秩信息，为模型服务安全审计提供重要参考。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可能影响所有提供公共基础模型加私有PEFT适配器的推理服务，特别是分类任务场景；相关风险可迁移到图像、多模态等任务，但需进一步验证。

items.title: Towards Decentralized Searcher Competition in MEV Markets
items.summary: Centralization in maximal extractable value (MEV) markets is a significant concern for blockchain systems, as persistent concentration of economic power can weaken competition, reduce openness, and undermine the decentralization goals of permissionless protocols. While much of the existing analysis has focused on builders, validators, and block-building markets, this paper studies centralization from the perspective of searcher competition. We develop a heterogeneous model in which searchers differ in opportunity coverage and execution efficiency, and we analyze how auction design affects fairness, decentralization, and security among searchers competing for the same MEV opportunity. To evaluate searcher competition, we introduce two metrics: a Shapley-weighted Jain fairness index, which measures whether rewards are proportional to searchers' marginal contributions, and an expected-reward Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI), which measures concentration in long-run searcher rewards. Using these metrics, we first analyze the standard first-price, winner-take-all auction as a benchmark. Our analysis shows that, under searcher heterogeneity, first-price competition can reward rank dominance rather than marginal contribution, leading to concentrated rewards and weaker contribution-adjusted fairness. Motivated by these limitations, we propose an entry-filtered Shapley-capped auction mechanism that distributes searcher rewards more fairly and broadly among admitted high-quality submissions. Designing such a mechanism in a permissionless blockchain environment is challenging: searchers may create Sybil identities by submitting copied or degraded versions of the same execution strategy, and validators may collude with searchers to increase joint payoff. We address these concerns through Bayesian security constraints for copied-code Sybil deviations and validator-searcher coalition deviations.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究区块链最大可提取价值（MEV）市场中的中心化问题，从搜索者（searcher）竞争视角出发，而非常见的构建者或验证者视角。作者构建了一个异质性模型，其中搜索者在机会覆盖范围和执行效率上存在差异，并分析拍卖设计如何影响竞争同一MEV机会的搜索者之间的公平性、去中心化程度与安全性。为评估搜索者竞争，提出了两个新指标：Shapley加权Jain公平指数（衡量奖励是否与搜索者的边际贡献成比例）和期望奖励的赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数（HHI，衡量长期搜索者奖励的集中度）。首先以标准的一价、赢者通吃拍卖作为基准进行分析，结果表明：在搜索者异质性条件下，一价竞争可能奖励排名主导地位而非边际贡献，导致奖励集中且贡献调整后的公平性减弱。基于这些局限，提出一种“入口过滤+Shapley上限”的拍卖机制，在已接纳的高质量提交中更公平、更广泛地分配搜索者奖励。但这类机制在无需许可的区块链环境中面临挑战：搜索者可能通过提交相同执行策略的复制或降级版本来创建女巫（Sybil）身份，验证者也可能与搜索者合谋以增加联合收益。论文通过贝叶斯安全约束来应对复制代码女巫偏差和验证者-搜索者合谋偏差。整体贡献包括：形式化搜索者异质性模型、新的公平性与集中度度量、以及兼顾抗女巫和抗合谋的拍卖机制设计。适合对MEV市场机制设计、区块链去中心化治理、拍卖理论以及加密经济学感兴趣的研究者、协议设计者和安全分析师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: MEV市场中心化威胁区块链去中心化根本原则，本文首次从搜索者竞争视角量化公平性与集中度，提出的机制和指标有助于安全研究人员评估协议级激励风险，为设计更抗女巫与合谋的拍卖方案提供理论基础。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响MEV拍卖协议（如Flashbots等）的机制设计，以及L1/L2区块链上MEV供应链的公平性与安全性评估场景。

items.title: The Hidden Life of Public Safety Communications Signals: A Comparative Security Analysis of TETRA, TETRAPOL, and P25
items.summary: Public-safety agencies and critical infrastructure operators rely on trunked land-mobile radio (LMR) systems, based on P25, TETRA, and TETRAPOL. These systems are expected to protect not just the content of a communication but the fact of it. Yet LMR standards leave a stark gap between confidentiality of \emph{content} and of \emph{communication}: underneath an encrypted traffic plane, their signaling plane is almost entirely in the clear. We probe the depth and impact of adversarial inference from this exposed signaling. Prior security analyses of these systems have concentrated on the content plane---recovering encryption keys or capturing accidental cleartext. We show that comparably sensitive information can be \emph{inferred from passively observed signaling even if the content encryption were perfect}. In particular, we show that across the trunked LMR standards, a passive, receive-only software-defined radio (SDR) observer can recover operationally sensitive network topology and geography details, unit presence, mobility across cells and groups, organizational structure, as well as operational security details such as special key domains and key-epoch rotation. This signaling-plane inference reaches far beyond the observer's direct area of reception, turning \emph{local} sniffing into \emph{nationwide} network mapping capabilities that degrade or defeat LMR standards' identity obfuscation through timing and association. In the case of TETRAPOL, we demonstrate how inference and tracking of such signaling metadata and a standards-level confidentiality failure in emergency call handling enable unencrypted voice extraction. Finally, we discuss potential countermeasures and mitigations, including specific recommendations for protecting inter-cell, base station and subscriber identities.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对公共安全与关键基础设施广泛依赖的集群陆地移动无线电（LMR）系统（包括P25、TETRA和TETRAPOL）展开安全分析。传统观念认为这些系统的加密流量平面能够保护通信内容，但作者指出其信令平面几乎完全明文暴露，导致通信的保密性与通信事实的保密性之间存在严重鸿沟。研究核心问题是：即使内容加密完美无缺，被动监听信令能否推断出敏感信息？作者通过实验证明，仅使用无源接收软件定义无线电（SDR）即可从信令中恢复网络拓扑、地理细节、单位存在性、跨小区移动性、群组归属、组织结构，以及特殊密钥域和密钥周期轮换等运营安全细节。更关键的是，这种信令推断能突破本地接收范围，将局部嗅探扩展为全国范围的网络映射，从而削弱甚至击败LMR标准通过时序和关联实现的身份混淆机制。在TETRAPOL案例中，作者还展示了紧急呼叫处理中的标准级保密性缺陷，使得结合信令元数据推断与跟踪能够导致未加密语音提取。最后，文章提出潜在对策与缓解措施，包括保护小区间、基站和用户身份的具体建议。本文的贡献在于首次系统比较三大LMR标准的信令平面暴露风险，并证明内容加密无法保护通信元数据的安全性。适合LMR系统设计者、公共安全通信主管、政府监管机构及无线安全研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 公共安全通信信令明文暴露可被被动嗅探，导致全国性网络映射和人员动向追踪，即使内容加密也无法防护，对一线行动安全构成实质性威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响P25、TETRA、TETRAPOL三类主流陆地移动无线电系统，波及公共安全机构、关键基础设施运营者；被动攻击成本低，可大规模实施，并可能泄露密钥域和轮换周期。

items.title: HoRFFI: High-Openness RF Fingerprint Identification with a Similarity-Enhanced Variational Information Bottleneck
items.summary: Radio frequency fingerprint identification (RFFI) is a promising technique for wireless device authentication. However, practical RFFI systems must enroll newly authorized devices while rejecting previously unseen ones, even when the feature extractor is trained on only a few labeled base-device classes, giving rise to a high-openness RFFI problem. Existing open-set recognition methods typically rely on feature spaces learned from a large and diverse set of known-device classes, limiting their applicability in practical scenarios. To address this challenge, we propose HoRFFI, a high-openness RFFI framework that supports scalable device identification and unknown-device rejection using only a small number of labeled training devices. HoRFFI employs a similarity-enhanced variational information bottleneck (SVIB)-based supervision mechanism, which reduces the encoder's dependence on training-class diversity and learns a more transferable embedding space. This supervision mechanism uses feature-space augmentation and clustering to derive inter-sample similarity information, which provides supplementary supervision for regularizing the embedding space. Experiments on public LoRa and Wi-Fi datasets show that HoRFFI achieves absolute improvements of \(0.112\) and \(0.288\) in novel-class accuracy, respectively, and corresponding absolute AUC improvements of \(0.029\) and \(0.060\) over the best-performing baselines.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究射频指纹识别（RFFI）在高开放性场景下的设备身份识别问题。在实际物联网或无线网络环境中，接入设备并非固定不变，系统既需要为新授权的设备进行注册识别，也需要拒绝从未见过的未知设备，而特征提取器往往只在少量已知设备类别上训练，这被称为高开放性RFFI问题。现有开放集识别方法通常依赖在大量且多样化的已知设备类别上学习到的特征空间，难以直接适用于训练样本稀少的实际场景。针对这一挑战，作者提出HoRFFI框架，仅使用少量标记训练设备即可实现可扩展的设备识别与未知设备拒绝。HoRFFI的核心是一种基于相似度增强的变分信息瓶颈（SVIB）监督机制，该机制通过特征空间增强和聚类提取样本间的相似度信息，为嵌入空间的规则化提供额外监督，从而降低编码器对训练类别多样性的依赖，学习到更具迁移性的嵌入表示。实验使用公开的LoRa和Wi-Fi数据集，结果表明HoRFFI在新类识别准确率上相比最优基线分别提升了0.112和0.288，在AUC（曲线下面积）上分别提升了0.029和0.060。该研究为低训练开销下的开放集射频指纹识别提供了新思路，适合无线安全、设备认证和物联网安全领域的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 无线设备认证是物联网安全的重要环节，而实际部署中往往只有少量标记设备，高开放性识别对蓝队监控未知设备有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到无线设备接入控制、非法设备识别、零日设备检测等场景，尤其适用于LoRa、Wi-Fi等物联网环境。

items.title: Hidden Ciphers and Where to Find Them: Static Discovery and Assessment of Cryptographic Assets in Software
items.summary: Modern software systems rely on cryptography for data protection, authentication, and trust establishment, yet organizations often lack a structured view of the cryptography deployed across source code, configuration, dependencies, and cryptographic files. This lack of visibility complicates security governance and post-quantum migration planning. This paper presents a static approach for discovering and assessing cryptographic assets in software systems. We introduce a classification of Crypto-Material, Crypto-Artifacts, and Crypto-Invocations, derive an extensible scanner-independent rule repository from it, and implement a static scanner that applies these rules to produce CBOM-oriented output. We evaluate the approach on a synthetic benchmark with known ground truth and on a real-world infrastructure of ten deployed services. The scanner achieves an F1 score of 0.75 for asset discovery and correctly annotates 91% of expected weaknesses and vulnerabilities. In the realworld setting, it processes 57 610 files in under six minutes and discovers 370 cryptographic assets, including six CVE-linked vulnerabilities and 52 post-quantum migration candidates. Real-world coverage is assessed against a manually compiled reference list rather than an exhaustive one. These results show that classification-driven static discovery can provide practical cryptographic transparency for governance and post-quantum migration planning.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种静态分析方法，用于在软件系统中自动发现和评估密码学资产。研究背景是：现代软件系统广泛依赖密码学实现数据保护、身份认证和信任建立，但组织往往缺乏对源代码、配置文件、依赖项和密码学文件中部署的密码学资产的统一视图，导致安全治理和量子迁移规划困难。核心思路是建立一套分类体系，将密码学相关元素分为三类：Crypto-Material（密码材料，如密钥、证书）、Crypto-Artifacts（密码学工件，如算法配置、协议参数）和 Crypto-Invocations（密码学调用，即代码中调用加密库的位置）。作者从该分类中推导出一个可扩展的、独立于扫描器的规则仓库，并实现了一个静态扫描器，应用这些规则生成符合CBOM（Cryptographic Bill of Materials，密码学物料清单）导向的输出。实验阶段，作者在具有已知基准的合成数据集上评估了工具，并在包含十个真实服务的基础设施上进行了验证。结果表明：在资产发现任务上，F1分数达到0.75；在预期弱点和漏洞的标注方面，正确率高达91%；在真实场景中，该工具能在六分钟内处理57,610个文件，发现370个密码学资产，其中包括6个与CVE相关的漏洞和52个量子迁移候选对象。真实环境的覆盖度根据手动整理的参考列表评估，而非穷举列表。本文的主要贡献在于证明基于分类驱动的静态发现能够为安全治理和量子迁移规划提供切实可行的密码学透明性。适合安全工程、DevSecOps团队以及负责密码学资产管理和合规检查的从业人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为蓝队和治理团队提供自动化的密码学资产盘点能力，帮助发现隐藏的密钥、过时算法和CVE关联风险，并直接支撑抗量子计算迁移的优先级决策。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于大规模代码库审计、供应链安全评估和合规性检查；可迁移到SBOM/CBOM生成、量子安全审计等场景。

items.title: Adaptive Intrusion Detection System using Transformer-Based Neural Networks and Continual Learning Approach with Adversarial Investigation
items.summary: Network intrusion detection systems (IDS) trained on fixed traffic snapshots decay silently after deployment as threat distributions shift. Fine-tuning models on new attacks triggers catastrophic forgetting, while retraining from scratch is computationally infeasible. Replay-based continual learning counters this, but existing methods unrealistically confine benign traffic to a single early task and ignore the replay buffer as a potential attack surface. To address this, we present an adaptive IDS framework coupling a tabular transformer encoder with a class balanced experience replay buffer that replays benign traffic at every update to stabilize decision boundaries. We introduce the class-instance incremental (CII) scenario where benign flows reappear alongside new attacks as a more faithful stress test, and probe the buffer with overt label flipping and stealthy backdoor poisoning attacks. On the CICIDS2017 benchmark, our framework achieved 0.9994 accuracy under the traditional class incremental setup and 0.9989 under CII, with negligible forgetting, drastically outperforming sequential fine-tuning (0.0052), EWC (0.0324), LwF (0.0699), and iCaRL (0.8770) baselines. While injecting benign traffic into every experience proves essential for preventing forgetting, the replay buffer introduces critical vulnerabilities. Label-flipping collapses the model entirely (0.0053 accuracy at a 1% budget), and the backdoor maintains 0.97 overall accuracy while driving the attack success rate on trigger flows to 95%, evading standard monitoring. Ultimately, while a modest replay budget recovers near-joint-training performance, ensuring buffer integrity emerges as a strict operational requirement.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的适应性入侵检测系统（IDS）框架，旨在解决传统IDS在固定流量快照上训练后，因威胁分布漂移导致的性能衰退问题。现有方法在应对新攻击时，微调会导致灾难性遗忘，而从头重训练计算成本过高。基于回放的持续学习虽能缓解遗忘，但现有方法不现实地将良性流量限制在单个早期任务中，且忽略了回放缓冲区本身可能成为攻击面。为此，作者将表格型Transformer编码器与类别均衡的经验回放缓冲区相结合，在每次更新时回放良性流量以稳定决策边界。同时，他们提出了类别-实例增量（CII）场景，即良性流量与新攻击同时出现，作为更真实的压力测试，并对回放缓冲区进行了显式标签翻转和隐蔽后门投毒攻击实验。在CICIDS2017基准上，该框架在传统类增量设置下达到0.9994的准确率，在CII设置下达到0.9989，遗忘极小，显著优于序列微调（0.0052）、EWC（0.0324）、LwF（0.0699）和iCaRL（0.8770）等基线。然而，实验也揭示回放缓冲区存在严重漏洞：1%预算的标签翻转使模型准确率崩坏至0.0053；后门攻击在保持整体准确率0.97的同时，对触发器流的攻击成功率高达95%，且能规避标准监控。研究表明，将良性流量注入每次经验是防止遗忘的关键，但缓冲区完整性成为严格的操作要求。本文适合网络安全研究者、IDS开发者和机器学习安全从业者阅读，以理解持续学习在入侵检测中的应用及其安全隐患。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了持续学习型IDS面临的新攻击面：回放缓冲区可被投毒导致模型崩溃或植入后门，且隐蔽性强。这对依赖增量学习的蓝队防御体系有直接警示意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响采用增量学习/回放机制的入侵检测系统，若缓冲区未受保护，攻击者可操纵历史数据降低检测能力或植入隐蔽后门。也可迁移至其他持续学习场景（如恶意软件分类）。
detection_signals_zh: 监控回放缓冲区数据异常修改或异常添加
模型在不同类别上的准确率突然恶化
特定触发流量行为与正常模式偏离
defense_advice_zh: 对回放缓冲区实施完整性校验和访问控制
采用差分隐私或鲁棒聚合方法增强抗投毒能力
定期审计缓冲区内容及模型行为一致性
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: UC, Categorically: Rigorous Diagrammatic Proofs
items.summary: Category theory is a mathematical theory of composition, widely used in logic, computing, and physics. Here we apply it to give a theory of secure composition. In particular, we provide a categorical treatment of Canetti's Universal Composability (UC) framework for systems with a static number of parties and sessions, often termed UC for static systems, yielding four benefits. First, we present our results graphically yet retain rigor by applying a standard categorical technique known as string diagrams. In particular, our formulation of the composition theorem can be graphically verified with a short sequence of diagrams, while remaining translatable to equations and amenable to formal verification. Second, categories let us generalize so that our results extend beyond interactive Turing machines to other forms of computation, such as quantum computation or domain-specific languages. Third, categories help us drop some unnecessary restrictions of UC (e.g., our adversary can be a computational network rather than a single Turing machine); we prove equivalence between our variant and the usual UC, showing no expressiveness is lost. Finally, the categorical perspective leads us to identify and correct some minor technical oversights in the standard formulation of simple UC.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文来自密码学与形式化方法交叉领域，旨在为 Canetti 提出的通用可组合性（UC）安全框架建立严格的范畴论基础。作者认为，传统 UC 框架依赖交互式图灵机（ITM）和复杂的组合证明，既难以图形化理解，也限制了其向量子计算等非经典计算模型的推广。论文的核心方法是引入范畴论中的 string diagrams（字符串图）技术，将安全组合定理的证明转化为直观的图形推导，同时保留严格的数学可翻译性和形式化验证能力。具体而言，作者针对静态参与方和会话数量的静态 UC 系统，给出了一个范畴论重构，实现了四个主要贡献：第一，通过图形化证明序列简洁地验证组合定理，并可与等式相互转换；第二，将结果泛化到任意计算模型，包括量子计算和领域特定语言，不再局限于图灵机；第三，放宽了 UC 中不必要的限制，例如允许对抗方为计算网络而非单一图灵机，并证明了该变体与标准 UC 在表达能力上等价；第四，利用范畴论视角发现了标准简单 UC 公式中的若干微小技术疏漏并予以纠正。该工作并非提供新的攻击或防御技术，而是为密码协议安全性分析提供更抽象、更可组合、更可验证的理论框架。适合密码学研究人员、形式化方法专家、安全协议设计者以及关注可组合安全性的理论计算机科学工作者阅读。由于仅依据摘要，本摘要未涉及实验数据或系统实现。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为 UC 安全框架提供严格的范畴论基础，使复杂的安全组合证明变得图形化、可验证，并能扩展到量子计算等新模型，有助于减少协议分析中的人为错误与形式化鸿沟。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可能影响安全协议的形式化验证工具与可组合安全性理论，为更广泛的计算模型（如量子协议）提供安全组合方法论，但近期不具备直接产品化影响。

items.title: ASTELD: A Six-Axis Classification Framework for Autonomous AI Agents - Design, Evaluation, and an OpenClaw Case Study
items.summary: Autonomous AI agent platforms differ substantially in architecture, security, tool integration, execution, autonomy, and deployment, yet the field lacks a common classification scheme for comparing these design choices. We propose ASTELD, an operational six-axis classification framework for autonomous AI agents: Architecture pattern, Security posture, Tool integration model, Execution paradigm, Level of autonomy and human control, and Deployment topology. ASTELD is constructed by synthesizing prior agent taxonomies with observable platform properties and explicit category-assignment rules. We evaluate its discriminative and explanatory utility by mapping eight representative frameworks and by using OpenClaw as an in-depth case study. The resulting profiles separate all eight platforms under their dominant configurations and reveal three cross-platform patterns: a security-accessibility diagonal, strong execution-architecture coupling, and capability convergence with persistent architectural differentiation. We further classify 50+ OpenClaw derivatives and find that innovation concentrates on the Security, Execution, and Deployment axes, indicating that ASTELD can explain where ecosystem fragmentation occurs. The OpenClaw case study also supplies a six-category vulnerability taxonomy, evidence from five institutional assessments, and adoption and governance analyses that connect platform coordinates to observed risks. These results position ASTELD as a reproducible method for comparing agent platforms, identifying unoccupied design regions, guiding framework selection, and organizing future empirical research. The analysis also exposes a consequential empty region: none of the evaluated systems combines local-first deployment with enterprise-grade security.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出并评估了一个用于自主AI代理平台分类的六轴框架ASTELD，旨在解决当前该领域缺乏统一分类方案的问题。ASTELD包含六个维度：架构模式（Architecture pattern）、安全态势（Security posture）、工具集成模型（Tool integration model）、执行范式（Execution paradigm）、自主性与人类控制级别（Level of autonomy and human control），以及部署拓扑（Deployment topology）。该框架通过综合既有代理分类法、可观察的平台属性和明确的类别分配规则构建。作者使用八个代表性框架进行映射，并以OpenClaw作为深度案例研究，评估了ASTELD的区分力和解释力。结果显示，ASTELD能够区分所有八个平台的主导配置，并揭示了三个跨平台模式：安全-可访问性对角线、强执行-架构耦合，以及能力趋同但架构持续差异化。进一步对50多个OpenClaw衍生平台进行分类后发现，创新集中在安全、执行和部署轴线上，表明ASTELD可解释生态系统碎片化发生的领域。OpenClaw案例研究还提供了六类漏洞分类法、来自五项机构评估的证据，以及将平台坐标与观察到的风险联系起来的采用与治理分析。研究还发现了一个重要的空白区域：所有被评估的系统均未将本地优先部署与企业级安全相结合。这些结果使ASTELD成为一种可复现的方法，用于比较代理平台、识别未占据的设计区域、指导框架选择以及组织未来的实证研究。本文适合AI安全研究员、代理平台开发者、安全架构师及制定AI治理策略的人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为安全人员提供了评估和比较自主AI代理平台安全性的结构化方法，有助于识别平台在安全、部署等维度的薄弱环节，尤其对于选择或审计代理平台的企业安全团队具有重要参考价值。

items.title: Season: Spectrum-Aware Orthogonal Gradient Refinement for Transfer-Based Adversarial Attacks
items.summary: Transfer-based adversarial attacks often transfer poorly across heterogeneous architectures because CNNs favor local textures while Vision Transformers (ViTs) rely on global shapes. We propose Season, a spectrum-aware orthogonal gradient refinement framework for L-infinity transfer attacks against black-box target models on ImageNet, using a white-box surrogate. Season decomposes each update into a low-frequency branch capturing structural cues and a high-frequency branch capturing textures. A low-saliency guidance scheme reallocates high-frequency energy to background regions, preserving foreground structures that ViTs depend on. An orthogonal projection then forces the textural update to lie in the orthogonal complement of the structural direction, mitigating feature interference. As a training-free plug-and-play wrapper, Season enhances eight gradient-stabilization and input-enhancement attacks without modifying their cores. Across eight CNN, ViT, and MLP targets, Season improves transfer success rate by 6.6 percentage points on average and up to 16.0 points over strong baselines under a unified protocol.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出一种名为 Season 的频谱感知正交梯度细化框架，用于提升基于迁移的对抗攻击成功率。研究背景是：传统卷积神经网络（CNN）偏向利用局部纹理特征，而视觉 Transformer（ViT）依赖全局形状信息，这种特征偏好差异导致对抗样本在不同架构之间迁移性较差。Season 的核心思想是将每次迭代的梯度更新分解为低频分支和高频分支：低频分支捕获结构线索，高频分支捕获纹理细节。通过低显著性引导机制，将高频能量重新分配到图像背景区域，从而保留 ViT 依赖的前景结构信息。随后，利用正交投影迫使纹理更新方向位于结构方向的零空间中，以缓解特征干扰。作为一个无需训练、即插即用的包装器，Season 可以增强现有梯度稳定化和输入增强类攻击方法（共 8 种），而不修改其核心算法。在 ImageNet 数据集上，使用白盒替身模型针对黑盒目标模型，Season 在 CNN、ViT、MLP 共 8 种目标模型上平均提升迁移成功率 6.6 个百分点，最高提升 16.0 个百分点，且实验协议统一、对比基准较强。该研究主要面向对抗攻击研究人员、模型鲁棒性研究者以及关注黑盒攻击评估的安全从业者，帮助理解跨架构迁移性的机制，并为防御侧的输入预处理、频谱滤波等研究提供参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 对抗样本跨架构迁移性威胁实际部署的 AI 系统，理解其频谱与正交投影原理有助于设计防御手段，如频谱异常检测或结构感知增强。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该框架适用于图像分类场景，可迁移至目标检测、语义分割等视觉任务，对黑盒模型安全评估有直接影响。

items.title: Manipulation-Proof Oblivious Audits against Deceptive Model Providers
items.summary: Audits have emerged as a critical instrument for algorithmic governance, providing a mechanism for external scrutiny and governance of machine learning models. However, ensuring the integrity of such assessments remains a challenging issue. For instance in regulatory contexts, audits are typically declared or easily detected, thus enabling model providers to manipulate the process, whether intentionally or inadvertently. This vulnerability is particularly acute in the context of fairness evaluations, in which providers can often infer sensitive attributes and strategically equalize allocation rates between groups to satisfy fairness metrics. In this paper, we introduce a novel audit protocol designed to significantly increase the post-audit detectability of such manipulations by enabling the auditor to query the model in an oblivious manner. Our approach leverages a Private Information Retrieval mechanism to require the provider to label a large set of instances, while preventing it from knowing which subset will ultimately be used for the audit. The protocol is efficient, imposes minimal overhead on the auditor, and requires no modification to the audited model, its training procedure, or its inference pipeline. We provide theoretical guarantees showing that, under this protocol, a provider attempting to hide unfairness must falsify a significantly larger number of responses, thereby increasing both the difficulty and the likelihood of detection of manipulation. Experimental results across representative audit scenarios confirm the effectiveness and practicality of our approach.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注机器学习模型审计中的完整性挑战。在监管场景下，审计通常是公开或可被检测的，模型提供方可能有意或无意地操纵审计过程，尤其是在公平性评估中，提供方可以推断敏感属性并策略性地调整不同组别的分配率以满足公平性指标。为此，论文提出了一种新颖的审计协议，通过让审计方以 oblivious（ oblivious ）方式查询模型，显著提高审计后操纵行为的可检测性。核心思想是利用私有信息检索（PIR）机制，要求模型提供方标注大量实例，但无法知道哪些子集最终会被用于审计。该协议高效，对审计方施加的额外开销极小，并且无需修改被审计模型、训练过程或推理管线。作者提供了理论保证，证明在该协议下，试图隐藏不公平性的提供方必须伪造更多响应，从而增加操纵的难度和被发现的概率。实验在多个代表性审计场景中验证了方法的有效性和实用性。该研究对算法治理、AI 公平性审计和第三方模型评估具有参考价值，适合算法审计研究者、AI 治理政策制定者以及平台安全团队阅读。

协议可检测到异常大量的响应伪造

结合 PIR 协议设计标准化的审计流程
在审计指南中明确要求提供方配合大规模标注以降低操纵空间

items.title: Adversarial Attacks for Good: A Survey of Proactive Protection across the Visual Content Lifecycle
items.summary: Once visual content enters an AI pipeline, its owner often retains little technical control over how it is used. Legal and regulatory remedies can address misuse, but many technical interventions must be applied earlier, when content is released or accessed. This survey examines the protective paradigm that has grown around this intervention point, which we call \emph{adversarial attacks for good}. Perturbations and structured signals long studied as attacks on learned models are instead applied by data owners, creators, platforms, or auditors to disrupt unauthorized automation or support later accountability. Five research communities have arrived at this inversion largely independently, each addressing a different stage of a visual asset's lifecycle: privacy filters against unwanted recognition at sharing time, unlearnable examples against unauthorized training, generative safeguards against malicious editing or imitation, adversarial CAPTCHAs for access control against automated agents, and provenance mechanisms for post-circulation attribution. Although developed in separate venues with incompatible success criteria, many of these methods exploit persistent gaps between human perception, semantic interpretation, and machine inference, suggesting that the paradigm remains relevant as visual pipelines evolve toward multimodal models and autonomous agents. To make their claims comparable, we evaluate all five families along shared axes of transferability, adaptability, and deployment readiness. Across the lifecycle, we find that most protections are still validated mainly against static or weakly adaptive adversaries, while evidence beyond controlled benchmarks remains scarce. We close by consolidating cross-stage countermeasures and open problems for robust, composable, and deployable owner-side protection.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文是一篇面向视觉内容全生命周期的综述，系统梳理了“用于善意的对抗攻击”（adversarial attacks for good）这一新兴防御范式。核心背景是：当视觉内容进入AI管道后，所有者对其后续使用方式几乎失去技术控制，法律和监管手段虽能事后追责，但许多技术干预必须在内容发布或访问时提前施加。作者将这一干预点上的保护手段统称为“用于善意的对抗攻击”，即把原本用于攻击学习模型的扰动或结构化信号，反过来由数据所有者、创作者、平台或审计方使用，以破坏未经授权的自动化处理或支持后续问责。综述识别出五个在视觉资产生命周期不同阶段独立发展的研究社区：1）隐私过滤：在分享时防止面部识别等非预期识别；2）不可学习样本：阻止未经授权使用数据进行模型训练；3）生成式防护：防止恶意编辑或模仿；4）对抗性验证码：用于访问控制以对抗自动化代理；5）溯源机制：支持内容流通后的归属与溯源。尽管这些方法在不同场合、以不同成功标准独立发展，但它们都利用了人类感知、语义理解与机器推断之间的持久差距，并且随着视觉管道向多模态模型和自主代理演进，这一范式仍具有现实意义。为了让不同方法可比，作者沿跨迁移性、适应性和部署就绪性三个共享轴评估了这五类方法。综述发现，大多数保护手段目前仍主要针对静态或弱自适应攻击者验证，超出受控基准的实际证据稀缺。最后，作者整合了跨阶段的对抗措施，并提出了构建稳健、可组合、可部署的所有者侧保护所需的开放问题。该综述的主要贡献在于统一了五个独立领域的概念框架，提供了横向比较维度，并指出了当前研究与实际部署之间的差距。适合关注AI安全、数据隐私、内容溯源以及对抗机器学习的蓝队安全工程师、AI系统开发者和政策研究者阅读。

items.title: Dimension Rigidity and Projective Geometry of Trace-Product Switchings of the Gold Cube
items.summary: We completely classify a natural scalar trace-product switching of the Gold almost perfect nonlinear function $x\mapsto x^3$ in every even dimension. Nontrivial switchings occur only for $n=4,6,8$: the admissible coefficients are, respectively, the nonzero trace-zero elements, the six elements of multiplicative order nine, and $\mathbb{F}_4^{*}$. For every even $n\geq10$, no nonzero coefficient is admissible. The infinite range is excluded by additive-character estimates on a Fermat cubic, with exact finite bridges for $n=10,12$. The raw coefficient lists for $n=6,8$ appeared earlier in Arshad's dissertation; our contribution is their intrinsic description, a proof uniform in the dimension, and the resulting dimension-rigidity theorem. We also classify normalized rank-two extensions in dimension eight by $\mathbb{P}^{1}(\mathbb{F}_4)$. A binary trace selector accepts two coefficient values at each non-base projective point, and the eight accepted marked switchings form exactly two extended-affine, hence two CCZ, classes. A centre-independent low-rank derivative criterion reduces each rank-$r$ candidate to $2^r-1$ membership tests in precomputed forbidden sets. The global APN classes reached are known; the results describe their local organization around the Gold centre and rule out this switching mechanism in all larger even dimensions.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文对Gold几乎完美非线性（APN）函数 x↦x^3 的一类自然标量迹积切换（trace-product switching）进行了完整分类，研究覆盖所有偶数维度。作者证明了非平凡切换仅出现在维度 n=4,6,8 中：对应可容许系数分别为非零迹零元素、乘法阶为9的6个元素以及 F_4^*。对于所有偶数 n≥10，不存在非零可容许系数。无限范围的排除依赖于对Fermat三次曲线的加性特征估计，并针对 n=10,12 给出了精确的有限桥接。n=6,8 的原始系数列表曾出现在Arshad的学位论文中，本文的贡献在于给出这些系数的内在描述、一个对维度统一的证明，以及由此得到的维度刚性定理。此外，作者在维度八中通过 P^1(F_4) 分类了归一化秩二扩展。一个二元迹选择器在每个非基射影点接受两个系数值，八个接受的标记切换恰好形成两个扩展仿射类，进而形成两个CCZ类。一个与中心无关的低秩导数准则将每个秩-r 候选者简化为在预计算禁止集中的 2^r-1 次成员测试。所达到的全局APN类别是已知的；这些结果描述了它们在Gold中心周围的局部组织，并排除了所有更大偶数维度中的这种切换机制。本文属于数学与信息论交叉研究，主要面向APN函数、密码学中的S盒设计以及有限几何研究者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究系统性地刻画了APN函数切换的维度限制，有助于理解密码学S盒的构造空间，避免在高维中依赖无效切换机制，为设计者提供理论边界。

items.title: Understanding Fault Tolerance of Adversarially Robust Pruned Models
items.summary: Deep neural networks (DNNs) deployed on resource-constrained neuromorphic hardware face three concurrent challenges: the need for model compression through pruning, vulnerability to adversarial input perturbations, and susceptibility to hardware-induced weight faults such as stuck-at-zero errors. While each of these factors has been studied in isolation, their combined effects on model reliability have received little attention. This paper presents an empirical investigation of how pruning, adversarial training, and hardware fault injection interact to affect the robustness of convolutional neural networks. Using a compact three-layer CNN trained on MNIST, we conduct three experiments: (1) comparing the fault tolerance of naturally and adversarially trained models under simultaneous hardware faults and adversarial attacks, (2) evaluating how pruning affects adversarial robustness, and (3) characterizing the joint accuracy surface across fault rates, adversarial perturbation magnitudes, and pruning levels. Our results show that adversarial training improves robustness against input perturbations but increases sensitivity to stuck-at-zero weight faults. Contrary to intuition, pruning did not significantly increase fault sensitivity, and varying the pruning level had little effect across fault rates and attack strengths. These results highlight the need to jointly consider adversarial robustness and hardware reliability.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对资源受限神经形态硬件上部署的深度神经网络（DNN）所面临的三个并发挑战进行了实证研究：剪枝导致的模型压缩、对抗性输入扰动、以及硬件故障（如 stuck-at-zero 权重错误）的影响。以往工作通常只孤立地研究这些因素，而本文首次联合考察剪枝、对抗训练和硬件故障注入如何共同影响卷积神经网络的鲁棒性。作者使用一个在 MNIST 上训练的紧凑三层 CNN，设计了三个实验：(1) 在同时存在硬件故障和对抗攻击的情况下，比较自然训练模型与对抗训练模型的容错能力；(2) 评估剪枝对对抗鲁棒性的影响；(3) 刻画故障率、对抗扰动幅度和剪枝水平三者联合作用下的精度曲面。实验结果表明：对抗训练虽然能提升对输入扰动的鲁棒性，但会显著增加对 stuck-at-zero 权重故障的敏感性；与直觉相反，剪枝并未显著增加故障敏感性，改变剪枝水平对故障率和攻击强度的影响也很小。这些发现强调了在部署神经形态硬件时，必须联合考虑对抗鲁棒性与硬件可靠性，而不能只针对单一因素进行优化。该研究为设计同时具备对抗安全性和硬件容错能力的模型提供了实证依据，适合硬件安全、对抗机器学习以及边缘 AI 部署领域的研究者和工程师阅读。

items.title: Open-World Darknet Traffic Recognition Under Leave-One-Service-Out Evaluation
items.summary: Darknet traffic recognition is critical for cyber threat intelligence, as anonymity networks are often used to conceal malicious activity. However, most existing studies rely on closed-world evaluation, assuming all service categories are known during training and testing, which is unrealistic in real-world environments. This paper presents an open-world darknet traffic classification framework using leave-one-service-out evaluation and uncertainty-aware classification with Random Forest and XGBoost models. Experimental results demonstrate significant performance degradation when transitioning from closed-world to open-world settings, demonstrating that closed-world evaluation substantially overestimates deployment robustness. For example, XGBoost Macro-F1 decreases from 88.8% to 46.1% in the I2P environment, while Random Forest performance drops from 87.4% to 45.7%. Although uncertainty-based rejection slightly improves robustness, strong behavioral similarity between known and unknown services leads to frequent misclassification. Semantic absorption analysis further shows that FreeNet video traffic is classified as browsing traffic with an 88.1% assignment rate, while I2P peer-to-peer traffic is absorbed into FTP-related behavior with an 83.4% assignment rate. The findings demonstrate that behavioral overlap remains a major challenge for reliable open-world darknet traffic classification.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究暗网流量的开放世界识别问题。传统暗网流量分类研究大多采用封闭世界评估，即假设训练和测试阶段涉及的服务类别完全已知，这在实际部署中并不现实。作者提出一种基于留一服务法（leave-one-service-out）评估的开放世界暗网流量分类框架，结合随机森林（Random Forest）和XGBoost模型，并引入基于不确定性的拒绝机制。实验使用I2P、FreeNet等暗网环境的数据，对比封闭世界与开放世界下的性能。结果表明，从封闭世界转向开放世界时，模型性能显著下降：XGBoost在I2P环境下的Macro-F1从88.8%降至46.1%，随机森林从87.4%降至45.7%。不确定性拒绝虽能小幅提升鲁棒性，但已知与未知服务之间的强行为相似性导致频繁误分类。语义吸收分析进一步显示，FreeNet视频流量以88.1%的比例被分类为浏览流量，而I2P点对点流量以83.4%的比例被吸收为FTP相关行为。作者强调，行为重叠是开放世界暗网流量可靠分类的主要挑战。该研究对于网络威胁情报、异常检测和匿名网络监控具有参考价值，适合从事流量分析、机器学习安全应用和暗网监测的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了封闭世界评估对暗网流量分类部署鲁棒性的高估问题，为蓝队设计真实场景下的匿名流量检测提供了开放世界评估思路，有助于避免模型在未知服务面前失效。

items.title: Securing Load Balancing over QUIC
items.summary: In-network load balancing outperforms traditional software load balancing while costing less. For instance, programmable switch ASICs can use hashing to select the backend server for the initial packet of each flow at the line rate. However, when the pool of available servers changes, ensuring that the subsequent flow packets are mapped to the same server is challenging due to the data plane's limited memory resources and performance requirements. With the emergence of the QUIC transport protocol, several works show how Connection ID fields (CIDs) can embed the server identifier for all non-initial packets. This approach requires modifications on the server side and violates the QUIC specification, which mandates that CIDs remain unlinkable. In this work, we show that stateless QUIC load balancing can be implemented inside the data plane with no changes to CIDs. Moreover, QUIC packets, except the initial client packet, can bypass the load balancer. We also investigate and mitigate attacks on QUIC in this scenario, including full load balancer bypass and 0-RTT IP spoofing.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文针对在QUIC协议上实现安全且高效的负载均衡问题展开研究。传统网络内负载均衡（in-network load balancing）相比软件负载均衡成本更低，例如可编程交换机ASIC可以利用哈希直连线速为每个流的初始包选择后端服务器。但当服务器池发生变化时，如何保证后续流的数据包仍被映射到同一台服务器，面临着数据平面有限内存和性能需求的挑战。随着QUIC传输协议的出现，已有工作提出利用连接标识（Connection ID, CID）字段嵌入服务器标识，使得所有非初始数据包都能被正确路由，但这种方法需要在服务器端进行修改，且违反QUIC规范中CID必须保持不可关联（unlinkable）的要求。本文提出了一种在数据平面内实现无状态QUIC负载均衡的方案，无需修改CID即可工作，并允许除客户端初始包以外的QUIC数据包绕过负载均衡器直接到达后端服务器。作者还研究了该场景下针对QUIC的攻击，包括完全负载均衡器绕过（full load balancer bypass）和0-RTT IP欺骗（0-RTT IP spoofing），并提出了相应的缓解机制。论文的主要贡献包括：设计并验证了符合QUIC规范的无状态、高性能负载均衡机制；展示了如何在不改变CID的前提下维持流到服务器的连续映射；分析了相关安全威胁并给出防御措施，增强了QUIC负载均衡的整体安全性。该研究对于数据中心网络、边缘计算和基于QUIC的服务集群具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: QUIC协议日益普及，本论文解决其负载均衡中的安全与合规性矛盾，有助于从业者理解如何在无状态数据平面实现高效LB，同时防范0-RTT欺骗等新攻击。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响使用QUIC的数据中心、CDN、云服务等负载均衡架构，以及依赖QUIC协议的应用部署安全性。

items.title: When Agents Learn to Be You: Benchmarking Privacy Leakage, Impersonation Risk, and Defenses in Persona Skills
items.summary: Persona skills distill personal interaction histories into portable and executable artifacts for downstream agents. While enabling flexible personalization, this process concentrates fragmented personal signals, amplifies their impact through reuse, and challenges defenses designed for individual records or retrieval-based memory. To systematically investigate the safety of the persona-skill pipeline, we introduce AntiSkillBench, an end-to-end benchmark for evaluating risks and defenses across the persona-skill pipeline. It comprises: (i) a dataset of 7,500 persona-grounded dialogue traces, constructed from 50 behaviorally rich profiles spanning diverse task scenarios; (ii) an evaluation suite that measures skill-level privacy leakage and agent-level attribute disclosure and behavioral impersonation across three skill-distillation strategies; and (iii) a defense evaluation covering four configurations across online and post-hoc interventions, including active risk suppression and passive provenance protection. Experiments across three frontier agents show that persona-skill risks persist across agent backbones and distillation protocols, extending from explicit attributes to communication styles and personality traits. Existing defenses exhibit limited and distillation-dependent effectiveness, failing to generalize across risk and distillation strategies. These results highlight AntiSkillBench as a challenging benchmark for developing privacy-preserving and authenticity-aware persona skills.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文系统性地研究了 AI Agent 中“人设技能”（Persona Skills）管线的隐私泄露与身份冒充风险。人设技能将个人交互历史提炼为可移植、可执行的工件，以便下游 Agent 复用，实现个性化服务。然而，这一过程会将碎片化的个人信号集中起来，通过复用放大其影响，并使得针对单个记录或基于检索的记忆的传统防御手段失效。为系统评估该管线的安全性，作者提出了 AntiSkillBench，一个端到端基准测试，覆盖风险与防御两方面。基准包含三部分：（1）由 50 个行为丰富的档案构建的 7,500 条基于人设的对话轨迹，涵盖多样化任务场景；（2）一套评估套件，可在三种技能蒸馏策略下衡量技能级隐私泄露、Agent 级属性泄露以及行为冒充程度；（3）防御评估，涵盖在线与事后干预的四种配置，包括主动风险抑制和被动来源保护。在三个前沿 Agent 模型上的实验表明，人设技能风险在不同 Agent 骨干和蒸馏协议下持续存在，影响范围从显式属性延伸到沟通风格和个性特质。现有防御措施效果有限且依赖于具体蒸馏策略，无法跨风险和策略泛化。这些结果凸显了 AntiSkillBench 作为开发隐私保护和真实性感知人设技能领域的挑战性基准的价值。本文适合从事 LLM 安全、隐私保护、AI Agent 可信赖性研究以及蓝队安全分析人员阅读，以理解新型攻击面并设计防御措施。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 人设技能管线将分散的个人数据集中化并复用，可能导致严重隐私泄露和用户冒充，而传统防御失效。该研究揭示的跨模型、跨蒸馏策略的风险传播特性，为蓝队提供了评估和防护此类新型攻击面的关键依据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响基于 Persona 技能的 AI Agent 应用，包括个性化助手、数字人、客服系统等。风险不限于显式敏感属性，还涉及沟通风格、个性等隐性特征，且可跨模型迁移，波及面广。
detection_signals_zh: Agent 输出中出现与用户历史记录高度一致的表达风格或偏好，超出正常个性化范围
同一人设技能被多个 Agent 复用后，出现跨会话的行为一致性异常
在蒸馏或推理过程中，观察到非预期的属性推断或身份伪装行为
defense_advice_zh: 采用主动风险抑制机制，在人设生成和复用过程中过滤敏感信号
实施被动来源保护，如为生成内容添加可追溯的元数据或水印
定期使用 AntiSkillBench 类似基准对 Agent 进行红队测试，评估隐私泄露与冒充风险
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Empirical Analysis of Evasion and Poisoning Against Malware Data Drift Detection
items.summary: As concept drift due to malware evolution presents challenges for malware classification, machine learning-based data drift detection tools are developed to mitigate this problem. These data drift detector tools are designed for a different purpose and built with different techniques compared to malware classifiers. Although evasion and poisoning attacks against machine learning-based malware classifiers can cause misclassification of malware samples, it is not clear how these attacks work against data drift detectors and malware classifiers in combination. This work investigates the effect of evasion and poisoning attacks on the data drift detector along with the malware classifier. We demonstrate how unique characteristics of data drift detectors cause attacks against malware classifiers to work differently against them.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对恶意软件分类中的概念漂移问题，分析了针对数据漂移检测器的逃避攻击和投毒攻击的影响。恶意软件的不断演化会导致概念漂移，从而降低分类器性能，因此研究者提出了基于机器学习的数据漂移检测工具来缓解此问题。然而，这些检测器在构建目的和技术上与恶意软件分类器不同。以往研究已证明针对分类器的逃避和投毒攻击可导致误分类，但这些攻击如何影响数据漂移检测器以及检测器与分类器组合后的效果尚不明确。本文通过实验研究了逃避攻击和投毒攻击对数据漂移检测器以及后续恶意软件分类器的影响，揭示了数据漂移检测器的独特特征（如对数据分布变化的敏感性、检测窗口机制等）会使针对分类器的攻击在作用于检测器时产生不同的效果。例如，攻击者可能通过精心构造的样本来干扰漂移检测信号，使得检测器无法及时触发模型更新，或诱使检测器产生误报警，从而间接削弱整个系统的防护能力。论文的主要贡献在于系统性地分析了攻击在漂移检测与分类协同工作场景下的传输与放大效应，为构建更健壮的恶意软件检测流水线提供了理论依据。适合安全研究人员、机器学习工程师以及蓝队成员阅读，以理解在持续学习环境中攻击面的变化。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了数据漂移检测器可能成为攻击链中的薄弱环节，导致恶意软件检测系统在对抗环境下失效。蓝队需关注ML流水线中检测组件自身的鲁棒性，避免仅防御分类器而忽略上游漂移检测被操纵的风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响使用机器学习进行恶意软件分类并依赖于数据漂移检测进行模型更新的安全系统；相关结论可迁移至其他基于流数据的异常检测场景。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Secure Long-Range Autonomous Valet Parking: A Reservation Scheme With Three-Factor Authentication and Key Agreement
items.summary: Long-range autonomous valet parking (LAVP) is increasingly adopted to alleviate traffic congestion and parking difficulties. For large-scale parking demand, reservation can improve parking management. However, existing schemes mainly focus on parking request verification and parking check-in, and do not adequately protect identity legitimacy and communication security during passenger drop-off and pick-up. To address this problem, we propose SecLAVP, a provably secure three-factor authentication and key agreement protocol for LAVP reservation services. SecLAVP combines passwords, biometrics, and smart cards. With assistance from the drop-off/pick-up point (DP), the passenger and the autonomous vehicle (AV) achieve mutual authentication and establish a session key for secure communication. In the Real-Or-Random (ROR) model, we formally prove that SecLAVP provides session-key security. AVISPA simulations show that SecLAVP resists man-in-the-middle attacks, while informal analysis demonstrates that it satisfies 15 defined security goals. Finally, performance evaluation in terms of communication overhead, computational overhead, and scheduling shows that SecLAVP is feasible for practical deployment.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对长距离自主代客泊车（LAVP）场景中的安全通信与身份认证问题，提出了一种名为 SecLAVP 的三因素认证与密钥协商协议。随着 LAVP 系统被广泛用于缓解交通拥堵和停车困难，大型停车场的预约管理变得日益重要。然而，现有方案主要关注停车请求验证与入场登记，在乘客上下车（drop-off/pick-up）环节中，对身份合法性和通信安全的保护不足。为此，SecLAVP 结合密码、生物特征和智能卡三种因素，在上下车点（DP）的辅助下，使乘客与自动驾驶车辆（AV）能够完成双向认证并建立会话密钥，确保后续通信的机密性和完整性。作者在 Real-Or-Random（ROR）模型中形式化证明了 SecLAVP 具备会话密钥安全性；使用 AVISPA 模拟工具验证其能够抵抗中间人攻击；并通过非正式分析表明该协议满足 15 项定义的安全目标。最后，从通信开销、计算开销和调度效率三个方面进行了性能评估，结果显示 SecLAVP 具备实际部署的可行性。该研究的核心贡献在于为 LAVP 预约服务提供了一种可证明安全的三因素认证机制，弥补了现有方案在乘客接送环节的安全缺口。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究直接关系到自动驾驶代客泊车场景中用户身份与通信的安全，对于车联网和智能交通系统的安全设计具有参考价值，安全工程师可关注其认证与密钥协商机制在类似IoT场景中的应用。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响 LAVP 预约服务的身份认证与通信安全，相关机制可迁移至其他需要多因素认证的物联网或车联网场景。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: When Modalities Fail to Tango: Conformal Backdoor Detection in Multimodal Contrastive Learning
items.summary: Backdoor attacks in multimodal contrastive learning (MCL) have garnered growing attention in recent years, as many downstream tasks critically depend on pre-trained MCL models. Existing detection-based defenses predominantly rely on the CLIPScore metric, under the assumption that poisoned pairs exhibit lower semantic similarity between the image and the caption. However, we identify two critical flaws remaining in existing methods: (1) the substantial overlap between CLIPScore distributions of benign and poisoned pairs undermines the reliability of this metric, and (2) fixed-threshold detection cannot provide statistical guarantees for ambiguous samples within overlapping regions. To overcome these limitations, we propose integrating conformal prediction (CP), a statistical framework that quantifies uncertainty through nonconformity scores (NCSs), to establish provable confidence bounds for detecting poisoned image-caption pairs. Building on CP, we introduce CASCADE, a novel two-stage Coarse-to-Fine Conformal Backdoor Detection framework. The coarse-grained stage uses cross-modality consistency to identify high-confidence benign and poisoned pairs. In the fine-grained stage, a reference set is constructed from high-confidence poisoned pairs, and instance-level NCSs based on text-space similarity are computed for each sample in the unidentified subset. These NCSs measure conformity to the poisoning distribution and enable precise identification of latent poisoned pairs within the unidentified subset. Extensive experiments on the large-scale CC3M dataset demonstrate that CASCADE achieves an average FPR of 5.79% at 100% TPR and an average AUROC of 0.9867 across diverse attacks, while remaining effective against adaptive attacks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 多模态对比学习（MCL）在视觉语言预训练中广泛应用，但面临后门攻击威胁：攻击者通过植入特定触发器，可诱导模型对带触发器的输入产生错误预测。现有检测防御主要依赖CLIPScore，假设被投毒图像-标题对的语义相似性显著低于良性对。然而，本文指出该假设存在两个关键缺陷：其一，良性对与被投毒对的CLIPScore分布存在大量重叠，使固定阈值无法可靠区分；其二，阈值选择缺乏统计保证，难以对重叠区域中的模糊样本提供可靠性判断。为克服上述局限，作者引入共形预测（Conformal Prediction, CP）框架，通过非一致性分数（NCSs）量化不确定性，从而为检测被投毒的对提供可证明的置信界限。基于CP，提出了CASCADE（Coarse-to-Fine Conformal Backdoor Detection）两阶段检测框架：粗粒度阶段利用跨模态一致性快速筛选出高置信度的良性对被投毒对；细粒度阶段则利用高置信度被投毒对构建参考集，对未识别子集中的每个样本计算基于文本空间相似性的实例级NCSs，以度量其与投毒分布的符合程度，精确识别潜在被投毒对。在大型CC3M数据集上的大量实验表明，CASCADE在多种攻击下实现了100%真正例率（TPR）下平均5.79%的假阳性率（FPR），平均AUROC达0.9867，且对自适应攻击保持有效性。该研究标志着多模态后门检测从启发式阈值向统计可保证方法的转变，为安全社区提供了更稳健的防御工具。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 多模态预训练模型的安全部署是AI安全的核心议题。论文揭示了现有CLIPScore后门检测的统计缺陷，提出基于共形预测的两阶段检测框架CASCADE，具备可证明的置信界，显著提升检测精度，为防御方提供了新的思路。值得模型部署方和安全研究员关注。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有依赖多模态对比学习预训练模型（如CLIP）的下游应用，包括图像检索、视觉问答、内容审核等。检测框架可推广到其他模态对，如音频-文本、视频-文本，以及多模态模型的后门审计场景。
detection_signals_zh: 跨模态语义一致性出现的异常分布（如图像-文本相似度分数与基准分布显著偏移）
文本空间相似性对参考投毒集的非一致性分数（NCSs）超出统计置信界限
在共形预测不确定区域内的样本，需进一步人工审查
defense_advice_zh: 在部署多模态预训练模型前，使用CASCADE框架进行后门扫描
建立动态阈值机制，基于共形预测产生的置信区间而非固定阈值进行判定
对高置信度投毒样本构建参考集，定期更新以应对自适应攻击
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Breaking ACDGV MinRank Gabidulin encryption schemes over matrix codes
items.summary: Enhanced Gabidulin Matrix Codes (EGMC), introduced by Aragon, Couvreur, Dyseryn, Gaborit, and Vincotte at Asiacrypt 2024, were designed to hide the algebraic structure of Gabidulin matrix codes while enabling very compact McEliece- and Niederreiter-type encryption schemes, with ciphertexts as small as $65$ bytes at the claimed 128-bit security level. Their security relies on the assumption that a masked EGMC code is hard to distinguish from a random matrix code. We show that this enhanced construction leaves enough structure for an equivalent code of the secret key to be recovered. Unlike previous cryptanalysis, our attack combines combinatorial and algebraic techniques to recover a Gabidulin-equivalent compressed code. This code can then be extended to a full-length equivalent secret key in polynomial time. As a result, the attack provides both a distinguisher and a key-recovery attack against the EGMC encryption schemes. The attack breaks all 16 proposed EGMC parameter sets by large margins. For example, for the claimed 128-bit parameter set $(2,17,37,4,0)$, it reduces the security level from 186 bits to 35 bits. In our implementation, the equivalent secret key is recovered in less than 10 minutes.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对 Aragon、Couvreur、Dyseryn、Gaborit 和 Vincotte 在 Asiacrypt 2024 上提出的增强 Gabidulin 矩阵码（EGMC）加密方案进行了密码分析。EGMC 旨在隐藏 Gabidulin 矩阵码的代数结构，同时实现非常紧凑的 McEliece 型和 Niederreiter 型加密方案，宣称在 128 位安全级别下密文可小至 65 字节。其安全性依赖于一个假设：屏蔽后的 EGMC 码与随机矩阵码难以区分。本文证明该增强构造仍保留了足够的结构，使得攻击者能够恢复与私钥等价的码。与之前的密码分析不同，该攻击结合了组合学与代数技术，先恢复一个 Gabidulin 等价的压缩码，然后在多项式时间内将其扩展为全长的等价私钥。该攻击同时提供了区分器与密钥恢复攻击，且以较大优势打破了所有 16 组 EGMC 参数集。例如，对于宣称 128 位安全性的参数集 (2,17,37,4,0)，安全级别从 186 位降至 35 位。在作者的实现中，恢复等价私钥用时不到 10 分钟。该研究揭示了基于矩阵码的加密方案在设计隐藏结构时的潜在缺陷，对后量子密码学中基于码的加密方案的安全性评估具有重要参考价值。适合密码学研究者、后量子密码标准化参与者以及关注基于码的加密方案安全性的安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该攻击直接打破了 Asiacrypt 2024 提出的紧凑型后量子加密方案，并大幅降低了宣称的安全级别，提醒蓝队和密码社区在信任新型基于码的加密构造前需经过深度安全性审查。

items.title: Beyond the QBER Threshold: A Temporal QBER Based Machine Learning Framework for Multi Attack Detection in BB84 QKD
items.summary: Conventional BB84 Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) systems rely on a fixed 11% Quantum Bit Error Rate (QBER) threshold to detect eavesdropping. However, stealthy attacks can remain below this threshold while still compromising channel security. This paper proposes a temporal QBER based machine learning framework for detecting and classifying eavesdropping attacks in BB84 QKD systems. Rather than relying on average session level QBER, the framework extracts 63 physics-informed temporal features capturing burst behavior, temporal instability, basis dependent asymmetry, and QBER loss interactions. Random Forest, XGBoost, and Support Vector Machine with a Radial Basis Function kernel (SVM-RBF) classifiers are evaluated on seven eavesdropping attacks and a normal channel scenario under noisy and lossy conditions. Averaged over ten independent runs, XGBoost achieves the best performance with 88.01% (0.47%) accuracy and a macro F1 score of 0.8803, while SVM-RBF performs comparably, confirming the robustness of the proposed features. Evaluated as a binary attack-versus-normal detector for comparison with conventional monitoring, a fixed 11% QBER threshold achieves only 25.82% accuracy with a False Negative Rate (FNR) of 0.8477, whereas the proposed framework reduces the FNR to 0.0198, substantially improving detection of stealthy attacks that evade threshold-based monitoring. SHapley Additive exPlanations based (SHAP) explainability shows that physics-informed temporal and channel derived features are highly discriminative for identifying eavesdropping strategies. These results demonstrate that temporal QBER driven machine learning provides an accurate, explainable, and practical framework for multi attack security monitoring in BB84 QKD systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对传统 BB84 量子密钥分发（QKD）系统在窃听检测中的局限性，提出了一种基于时间量子误码率（QBER）的机器学习框架。传统方法通常依赖固定的 11% QBER 阈值来判定是否存在窃听，但隐秘攻击可能使 QBER 保持在阈值之下，从而绕过检测。为克服这一弱点，作者提取了 63 个物理信息时间特征，涵盖突发行为、时间不稳定性、基选择不对称性以及 QBER 损失交互等维度，以捕获攻击引起的细微时间模式。采用随机森林、XGBoost 和支持向量机（RBF 核）三种分类器，分别在七种窃听攻击和正常通道场景下进行实验，并考虑了噪声和有损条件。平均十次独立运行，XGBoost 取得了最佳性能，准确率达到 88.01%（±0.47%），宏 F1 分数为 0.8803；SVM-RBF 性能相近，验证了所提特征的鲁棒性。作为二分类器（攻击 vs 正常）与常规监控比较，固定 11% QBER 阈值仅达到 25.82% 的准确率，假阴性率（FNR）高达 0.8477；而所提框架将 FNR 降至 0.0198，显著提升了对低于阈值窃听攻击的检测能力。此外，基于 SHAP 的解释性分析表明，物理信息时间特征和信道派生特征对识别窃听策略具有很强的判别力。实验结果证明，基于时间 QBER 的机器学习能够为 BB84 QKD 系统提供准确、可解释且实用的多攻击安全监控方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: QKD 是未来安全通信的基石，但传统阈值检测存在盲区。该研究提供了一种可落地的机器学习检测框架，能显著降低假阴性率，对部署 QKD 的安全团队具有重要参考价值，也为物理层安全监控提供了新思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于 BB84 QKD 系统的多攻击检测，也可拓展至其他 QKD 协议或物理层安全监测场景，如量子网络中的异常行为识别。

items.title: Provably Learning Multi-Head Attention with Queries
items.summary: We study the problem of learning multi-head softmax attention from black-box input-output access. The learner may query arbitrary real-valued token sequences and observe only the scalar output at the final token. Recent work gives an algorithm using $O(d^2)$ value queries to recover the single-head parameters $(W,v)$. For multiple heads, the same work establishes identifiability under the assumption that the heads occupy pairwise orthogonal subspaces. Applying the single-head recovery algorithm separately to the heads additionally requires bases for these subspaces to be known. We recover a canonical representation by merging heads with the same $W_h$, summing their corresponding $v_h$, and discarding a merged head when this sum is zero, without these subspace assumptions. By varying the number of copies of a token, our algorithm obtains samples of a rational function whose interpolation separates the canonical heads. Additional queries formed by adding selected token vectors then match the same head across different queries. When the oracle outputs and all subsequent computations are exact, the learner chooses its query vectors at random and recovers the canonical pairs $\{(W_h,v_h):h\in[H]\}$ up to permutation with probability one. When $H$ is known, it uses exactly $4Hd^2-2H+1$ value queries of maximum length $2H+1$. If only a known upper bound $H_0$ is available, the algorithm uses $4H_0d^2-2H_0+1$ value queries of maximum length $2H_0+1$. For approximate oracle outputs, we give conditions under which the parameter error is at most a model- and query-dependent constant multiple of the output error. Finally, we extend our result to a one-layer Transformer with multi-head attention followed by a bias-free ReLU feed-forward network. Under additional conditions, we recover a functionally equivalent Transformer without relying on a separate algorithm for learning the feed-forward network.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文研究从黑盒输入输出访问中学习多头 softmax 注意力机制的理论问题。具体设定为：学习器可查询任意实数 token 序列，并仅能观察到最终 token 上的标量输出。此前工作提出用 O(d^2) 次值查询恢复单头注意力参数 (W, v)，但对于多头情况，需要在“头占据 pairwise 正交子空间”的假设下才能保证可识别性，且将单头恢复算法分别应用于各头时还要求已知这些子空间的基。本文去除了上述子空间假设，提出一种算法：首先通过合并具有相同 W_h 的头，将对应 v_h 求和，若和为 0 则丢弃该合并头，从而恢复一个规范表示。核心思想是：通过改变某个 token 的重复次数，算法可获得一个有理函数的采样，利用插值原理分离出不同的规范头；再通过添加特定 token 向量的额外查询，将不同查询中属于同一头部的参数匹配起来。在精确计算环境下，若 H 已知，算法恰好使用 4Hd^2 - 2H + 1 次值查询，最大查询长度为 2H + 1；若只知道上界 H0，则使用 4H0d^2 - 2H0 + 1 次查询。对于近似输出，论文给出了条件，使得参数误差至多为模型和查询相关的常数乘以输出误差。最后，该结果被扩展至一层 Transformer（多头注意力后接无偏置 ReLU 前馈网络），在附加条件下，无需专门设计用于学习前馈网络的独立算法，即可恢复一个功能等价的 Transformer。这篇论文属于理论贡献，主要面向关注注意力机制可学习性与可解释性的研究者。

items.title: A Note on the Influence of a Zero Length Nonce on GCM and GMAC
items.summary: In this note, we show a simple attack that can recover the hash key of GCM and GMAC by using a zero length nonce. After recovering the hash key, the adversary can forge an arbitrary ciphertext or message as she wants. We note that the ISO/IEC version of GCM and GMAC allows the nonce to be a zero length string, while the NIST version of GCM and GMAC explicitly requires the nonce to be at least one bit. Hence, our attack works for the ISO/IEC version and cannot work for the NIST version.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文针对 GCM 和 GMAC 认证加密算法在 nonce 长度为零时的安全性问题展开研究。GCM 是一种广泛使用的认证加密模式，基于计数器模式和 GHASH 通用哈希函数；GMAC 是它的变体，用于消息认证。该算法内部依赖一个哈希密钥 H 来生成认证标签。研究指出，ISO/IEC 版本的 GCM/GMAC 标准允许使用零长度字符串作为 nonce，而 NIST 版本则明确要求 nonce 至少为 1 位。论文展示了一个简单攻击：当 nonce 长度为零时，攻击者可以通过构造特定的查询来恢复哈希密钥 H。一旦恢复 H，攻击者就可以伪造任意密文或消息，从而完全破坏认证性和完整性。由于 NIST 版本要求 nonce 非零，因此该攻击仅适用于 ISO/IEC 版本，对 NIST 版本无效。这篇论文的贡献在于揭示标准之间的不一致性，并强调零长度 nonce 的潜在风险。适合密码学研究者、标准实现者以及使用 GCM/GMAC 的安全工程师阅读，以了解实现时需要注意 nonce 长度的约束，避免因标准兼容性而引入安全漏洞。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: GCM 和 GMAC 在 TLS、IPSec 等协议中广泛使用，零长度 nonce 虽然看似边缘，但一旦被允许，攻击者即可恢复哈希密钥并伪造任意数据，完全绕过认证机制。提醒实现者和使用者注意 ISO/IEC 与 NIST 标准的差异，避免受影响。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 采用 ISO/IEC 版本的 GCM/GMAC 且允许零长度 nonce 的加密系统或库可能受影响；NIST 版本及非零 nonce 的实现不受影响。
detection_signals_zh: 检测到 GCM/GMAC 操作中 nonce 字段长度为零（例如应用日志或网络抓包中 nonce 为空）
实现库中出现的标准标识为 ISO/IEC 版本且未对 nonce 长度进行校验
defense_advice_zh: 严格遵循 NIST 要求，强制 nonce 长度至少为 1 位
在调用 GCM/GMAC 前增加 nonce 长度校验，拒绝零长度 nonce
对现有系统进行审计，确认使用的 GCM/GMAC 标准版本及 nonce 处理逻辑

Software installed and run as a non-privileged user may conduct improper GPU system calls to trigger OOB access and kernel null pointer dereference in an error path.



Null pointer dereference occurs in an error path of a function running in kernel thread of execution leading to kernel exceptions, platform instability and denial of service.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-45204 是 NVD 收录的一则漏洞，涉及软件以非特权用户身份安装和运行时，可通过构造不当的 GPU 系统调用来触发越界（OOB）访问，并在内核线程执行路径的错误处理分支中导致空指针解引用。攻击者不需要任何特权，仅需具备普通用户身份即可在目标设备上发起此类调用。一旦触发，内核线程中的空指针解引用会引发内核异常、平台不稳定以及拒绝服务（DoS）。该漏洞的核心成因在于 GPU 相关内核模块对系统调用的参数校验不充分，未能有效防止非特权用户传递导致错误路径的非法输入。由于受影响的 GPU 驱动通常运行在内核态，因此该问题可能直接导致系统崩溃或需要重启，从而影响可用性。目前 NVD 未提供该漏洞的 CVSS 评分、EPSS 数据，也未列出受影响的具体产品和厂商信息，因此无法精确判断其影响范围。但从漏洞性质看，它属于本地拒绝服务类问题，攻击者需要具备本地访问权限，且利用复杂度可能较低。值得注意的是，该漏洞并未被列入 KEV 目录，也没有明确证据表明其已被在野利用，因此该信息仅基于元数据，实际利用状态需要进一步跟踪厂商公告和安全研究进展。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许本地非特权用户通过恶意 GPU 系统调用触发内核空指针解引用，造成系统崩溃和拒绝服务，对多用户环境或终端设备的稳定性构成威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可导致内核异常、平台不稳定，进而引发系统崩溃或拒绝服务，严重影响目标系统的可用性。

items.summary: PILOS (Platform for Interactive Live-Online Seminars) is a frontend for BigBlueButton. From 2.1.0 until 4.14.1, PILOS does not send a Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy response header, so pages opened by PILOS via a link that opens a new browsing context (e.g., target="_blank") retain a window.opener reference back to the originating PILOS tab. A malicious destination page reached this way can use window.opener to navigate or manipulate the original PILOS tab, a technique known as reverse tabnabbing, potentially redirecting an authenticated user to a phishing page that mimics PILOS. This issue is fixed in version 4.14.1.

items.summary:
AIL Project contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the translation controls displayed for chat messages and forum posts.

The affected templates inserted message and post identifiers directly into inline JavaScript onclick handlers:

onclick="translateMessageToPreferredLanguage('{{ message['id'] }}', '{{ mess_id_escape }}', this)"

and:

onclick="translatePostToPreferredLanguage('{{ post['id'] }}', '{{ post_id_escape }}', this)"

These values were HTML-template escaped but were not safely encoded for use as JavaScript string literals inside an HTML attribute. A specially crafted identifier containing quotation marks, escape characters, or other JavaScript syntax could therefore terminate the expected string argument and inject arbitrary JavaScript into the event handler.

Because the affected values are associated with indexed chat messages or forum posts, a malicious value may remain stored by AIL and be rendered whenever an analyst accesses the corresponding chat or forum explorer view.

Successful exploitation requires the victim to click the affected Translate to preferred language button. The injected code would then execute in the victim’s browser under the security origin of the AIL instance.

items.title: AIL Framework contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the crawler domain view. Crawled URLs were embedded directly into the JavaScript onclick handler used to di...
items.summary:
AIL Framework contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the crawler domain view. Crawled URLs were embedded directly into the JavaScript onclick handler used to display a stored screenshot, without context-appropriate encoding.

An attacker who can cause a specially crafted URL to be recorded in the crawler history can inject JavaScript syntax into the stored URL value. The payload remains stored by AIL and is subsequently included in the domain view. When an authenticated analyst clicks the screenshot icon associated with the malicious URL, the injected JavaScript executes in the analyst’s browser within the security context of the AIL Framework application.

Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to access information available to the analyst’s session, modify displayed content, or perform application actions using the analyst’s privileges. Exploitation requires the victim to interact with the affected screenshot entry.

The vulnerability was corrected by serializing the crawled URL with Jinja’s tojson filter before inserting it into the JavaScript handler. This safely escapes characters that could otherwise terminate the JavaScript string and introduce executable code.

items.summary:
AIL Framework contained a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in the /tag/add_tags endpoint. When an error occurred while processing a tag operation, the application returned the error value directly as an HTML response using str(res[0]).

If attacker-controlled input was included in the generated error message, a crafted request could cause arbitrary HTML or JavaScript to be reflected in the response without appropriate output encoding. An attacker could exploit the vulnerability by convincing an authenticated AIL Framework user to open a specially crafted link.

Successful exploitation could allow JavaScript to execute in the victim’s browser within the security context of the AIL Framework application. Depending on the victim’s privileges and the application’s protections, the attacker could perform actions using the victim’s session, access information available to the victim, or modify data through authenticated application requests.

The vulnerability requires user interaction because the authenticated victim must follow or open the crafted request. The attacker does not necessarily require an AIL Framework account, provided that the crafted request can be delivered to an already authenticated user.

items.summary: Traefik is an open source HTTP reverse proxy and load balancer. Prior to 2.11.53, 3.6.24, and 3.7.9, Traefik's default HTTP reverse proxy forwards a plain HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 CONNECT request and its body to an HTTP/1.1 upstream through a shared net/http.Transport. When the upstream answers the CONNECT with a keep-alive non-2xx response and does not drain the body, Traefik returns the desynchronized backend socket to its shared pool and reuses it for other clients. An unauthenticated attacker can use this behavior to make a different client read the attacker's smuggled response, which can include authenticated or private content from another request. The ForwardAuth middleware with forwardBody true and preserveRequestMethod true can re-issue a CONNECT with the buffered body attached, exposing the auth-client pool to the same desynchronization. This issue is fixed in 2.11.53, 3.6.24, and 3.7.9.

items.title: Dinky's SysConfigController.getAll() handler for GET /api/sysConfig/getAll carries a method-level @SaIgnore annotation that short-circuits the class-level @SaCheckLogin, so the ...
items.summary: Dinky's SysConfigController.getAll() handler for GET /api/sysConfig/getAll carries a method-level @SaIgnore annotation that short-circuits the class-level @SaCheckLogin, so the Sa-Token interceptor lets the request through with no session or role check. Any remote unauthenticated caller who can reach the Dinky HTTP port (8888 by default) receives the full live system configuration (54 entries on a stock v1.2.5 install) with one parameterless GET. Only one credential field (sys.maven.settings.repositoryPassword) has a desensitization handler wired; the other credential-bearing fields (sys.env.settings.dinkyToken, sys.ldap.settings.userPassword, sys.resource.settings.oss.accessKey and secretKey, and sys.dolphinscheduler.settings.token) return in cleartext. A bare install leaks the shipped defaults, including the hardcoded dinkyToken efda1551-7958-4e0f-80a8-dfd107df3e38 and minioadmin/minioadmin OSS keys; once an operator configures LDAP, object storage, or DolphinScheduler through the Settings Center, those live third-party credentials leak from the same endpoint. Because dinkyToken is the sole gate on the sibling POST /download/uploadFromRsByLocal arbitrary file write, this disclosure defeats token rotation as a mitigation for that vulnerability. Affects Dinky v1.2.5 (the current release, 2025-11-05) and the development branch (dev HEAD 63b5a5a), where the affected code is byte-identical.

items.title: diboot-core's POST /common/load-related-data endpoint resolves caller-supplied field names to any @TableField column of any entity and returns those values for all rows, with no...
items.summary: diboot-core's POST /common/load-related-data endpoint resolves caller-supplied field names to any @TableField column of any entity and returns those values for all rows, with no field or entity allowlist. The only guard, relatedDataSecurityCheck(), returns true unconditionally, so any authenticated user (including a zero-role account) can read @JsonIgnore-annotated secret fields such as IamAccount.authSecret and IamAccount.secretSalt for every account, or arbitrary secret fields of any other entity. Shiro's two-iteration MD5 with an 8-character salt is trivially crackable offline, so the disclosed admin password hashes convert to full administrative takeover. The endpoint is not example code; the official diboot-admin-ui frontend requires it, so deployments following the vendor's recommended integration expose it. The mechanism was renamed relatedData* to attachMore* on the development branch, but attachMoreSecurityCheck() also returns true unconditionally.

items.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

x86/bugs: Make Safe-RET robust against interrupt injection

An attacker injecting interrupts while the Safe-RET mitigation executes
on machines affected by SRSO can neutralize the safe return sequence,
potentially leading to data leakage through speculative execution.

Fixup register state as if the Safe-RET sequence executed successfully
by "emulating" it, in a manner of speaking, and avoid executing a RET
instruction after returning from the interrupt.

items.summary: PHP_CodeSniffer tokenizes PHP files and detects violations of a defined set of coding standards. Prior to versions 3.13.6 and 4.0.2, PHP_CodeSniffer contains a command injection vulnerability in the code that generates the Gitblame, Hgblame, and Svnblame report formats. As a result, running PHP_CodeSniffer over untrusted files, for example in a continuous integration pipeline that scans pull requests, or on a developer machine reviewing third party code, could result in attacker controlled shell commands being executed when the Gitblame, Hgblame, or Svnblame report processes a file whose name contains shell metacharacters. Users using the default Full report, or any of the other non-blame reports, are not affected. Users on a runtime platform which does not allow filenames to contain shell metacharacters, such as " and ;, are not affected. This issue is fixed in versions 3.13.6 and 4.0.2.

items.title: pymdown-extensions is a collection of extensions for the Python Markdown library. In versions up to and including 11.0, four inline processors (caret, tilde, betterem, and magic...
items.summary: pymdown-extensions is a collection of extensions for the Python Markdown library. In versions up to and including 11.0, four inline processors (caret, tilde, betterem, and magiclink) use regular expressions whose content groups can partition a run of delimiter characters in exponentially many ways, causing catastrophic backtracking. As a result, a single untrusted Markdown line under 50 bytes rendered with markdown.markdown() in each extension's default configuration drives the rendering thread into unbounded CPU usage that grows exponentially with input length, enabling an unauthenticated remote attacker who can submit Markdown to cause denial of service. The exposure is concrete for web applications that render user-supplied Markdown (comments, wikis, issue bodies, live preview), including any app using pymdownx.extra which bundles the vulnerable betterem default, as well as hosted docs/CI systems that build untrusted Markdown. The issue has been fixed in version 11.0.1.

items.summary: GitHub CLI (gh) is GitHub’s official command line tool. Prior to 2.97.0, gh attestation verify  builds the certificate Subject Alternative Name matcher from the --signer-repo and --signer-workflow  flag values without escaping regex metacharacters, so a user-supplied repository or workflow name is treated as a regular expression rather than a literal string. Because GitHub permits characters such as  `.`  in organization, repository, and workflow path names and  `.`  is a regex wildcard, an attacker can register a lookalike name (for example github/artifact.attestations-workflows) that satisfies a matcher intended for a different trusted signer (github/artifact-attestations-workflows), bypassing the intended Sigstore attestation verification. Exploitation requires the attacker to create a plausible lookalike repository and produce valid attestations from it, which could undermine supply chain verification for CI/CD pipelines or policy gates that pin trust to a specific signing workflow. This issue is fixed in version 2.97.0.

items.summary: GitHub CLI (gh) is GitHub's official command line tool. Prior to version 2.97.0, gh auth status masked only the characters after the last underscore in certain fine-grained personal access tokens and GitHub App tokens. items.summary: PyMdown Extensions is a set of extensions for the Python-Markdown markdown project. An application that renders untrusted Markdown with pymdownx.b64 enabled can therefore leak the contents of image-extension files readable by the process to whoever controls the Markdown or views the output, a targeted file-read bounded by the extension check. This issue has been fixed in version 11.0.

items.summary: Ground Station prior to 0.6.0 contains an unauthenticated blind server-side request forgery vulnerability in the orbital-source configuration path that allows any unauthenticated Socket.IO client to cause the ground-station process to issue outbound HTTP requests to attacker-chosen destinations. HTTP status codes and error messages from the outbound request are emitted in the orbital_sync_state Socket.IO event to all connected clients, providing a serviceable oracle for interpreting internal-service and cloud-metadata responses even though the raw response body is not directly leaked. Because the malicious source persists in the database across restarts and re-fires every 24 hours on the scheduled sync cycle, the primitive gives durable long-term SSRF without the attacker needing to remain connected.

items.title: OpenReception's appointment booking software provides an end-to-end encrypted appointment booking platform. Versions prior to 1.0.2 don't throttle failed passphrase login attemp...
items.summary: OpenReception's appointment booking software provides an end-to-end encrypted appointment booking platform. Versions prior to 1.0.2 don't throttle failed passphrase login attempts. An attacker can submit unlimited wrong passphrase guesses against any known email address, capped only by the Argon2 verification cost (about 100 milliseconds per attempt on the tested host, giving 10 attempts per second sustained). The same backend implements a working per-account throttle on the WebAuthn challenge endpoint, which returns HTTP 429 after roughly 19 attempts. The passphrase branch simply does not invoke that throttle, leaving a supported high-value login path unprotected against credential stuffing and dictionary attacks. The asymmetry confirms this is an oversight rather than a design choice. The throttle infrastructure exists, is wired into the same auth backend, and works on the WebAuthn path. The passphrase branch in `/api/auth/login` was not updated to record failed attempts. Combined with the application's minimum-passphrase policy (12 characters, no entropy or dictionary checks), accounts using common base patterns such as `Spring2026!XX` or words from a leak corpus are realistically reachable in days on a single CPU, hours on a small GPU farm. Version 1.0.2 patches the issue.

items.summary: OpenReception's appointment booking software provides an end-to-end encrypted appointment booking platform. Prior to version 1.0.6, the bootstrap challenge endpoint at `/api/tenants/{id}/appointments/bootstrap-challenge` issues a SHA-256 proof-of-work with `difficulty=4` hex zeros, equivalent to 16 bits of work. Modern hardware solves this in under 200 milliseconds, providing essentially no friction against automated abuse of the patient booking flow. Proof-of-work is used in the booking flow as a rate-limiter for unauthenticated clients establishing tunnels and submitting appointments. At 16 bits of difficulty, the construct is decorative rather than effective. An attacker can solve PoW challenges as fast as the server can issue them, defeating the rate-limiting purpose. The handler also calls `challengeThrottleService.checkThrottle(binding, "passkey")`, but the binding includes attacker-controlled values (`tunnelId`, `clientPublicKey`, and optional `emailHash`). For each fresh attempt, the attacker can supply new values, producing a new throttle key and bypassing the per-binding accumulation. Practical abuse friction is therefore the PoW difficulty itself, not a stable per-IP or per-email server-side throttle. Version 1.0.6 fixes the issue.
